author: 太宰治
quoteCn: 抱歉，我生而为人。
quoteEn: "I apologize for being born."

author: 芥川龙之介
quoteCn: 人生如一盒火柴，不必过于较真，那显得愚蠢；可若全然不顾，又恐引火烧身。
quoteEn: Life is like a box of matches. It's silly to take it too seriously, but it can be dangerous if you don't.

author: 夏目漱石
quoteCn: 人，生来孤独。然而，不必因此而畏惧。
quoteEn: Human beings are lonely. However, one must not be afraid of loneliness.

author: 太宰治
quoteCn: 我们自以为的自由，不过是命运掌中的一场幻觉。
quoteEn: Human beings are not as free as they think they are.

author: 太宰治
quoteCn: 幸福，是那份蓦然回首，发现自己早已身在幸福之中的觉察。
quoteEn: Happiness is realizing that you are happy.

author: 芥川龙之介
quoteCn: 人生，比地狱更地狱。
quoteEn: Life is more hellish than hell itself.

author: 北野 武
quoteCn: 人啊，你以为自己刀枪不入，也以为自己不堪一击。其实，你远比想象的更具韧性，也比想象的更易碎。
quoteEn: Humans are neither as strong nor as weak as they think they are.

author: 夏目漱石
quoteCn: 人啊，你既非你想象中那般高不可攀，亦非你以为的如此微不足道。
quoteEn: Humans are neither as great nor as lowly as they think they are.

author: 太宰治
quoteCn: 你以为的孤独，其实从未如此绝对。
quoteEn: Human beings are not as alone as they think they are.

author: 太宰治
quoteCn: 我，不过是一具披着人皮的怪物。
quoteEn: I am a monster wearing human skin.

author: 道元
quoteCn: 修习佛道，是打磨灵魂的旅程。而这打磨至深处，便是忘却小我，融入万物。
quoteEn: To practice the Buddhist way is to refine oneself. To refine oneself is to forget oneself.

author: 手塚治虫
quoteCn: 我愿以笔为舟，航行于漫画的海洋，只为触及并描摹人类心灵深处那片最柔软的风景。
quoteEn: I want to depict the human heart through drawing manga.

author: 芥川龙之介
quoteCn: 人啊，总有千万种方式，与自己虚与委蛇。
quoteEn: Humans use every means to deceive themselves.

author: 夏目漱石
quoteCn: 我们都需要一面镜子，映照出那个未曾被自己完全看清的灵魂。
quoteEn: Humans need others to know who they are.

author: 道元
quoteCn: 众生皆具佛性，那份本自具足的清净与智慧，从未远离。
quoteEn: All sentient beings have Buddha-nature.

author: 九鬼周造
quoteCn: 自由的真谛，在于我们能否坦然接纳生命中的一切无常与偶然。
quoteEn: Human freedom is based on the recognition of contingency.

author: 安部公房
quoteCn: 人，唯有在彻底迷失之后，才真正寻回自己。
quoteEn: Human beings find themselves by losing themselves.

author: 石川啄木
quoteCn: 轻佻地背起母亲，却被她那份轻盈击溃，未及三步，泪已模糊了双眼。
quoteEn: Carrying my mother in jest, I cry at how light she is, and I do not take three steps

author: 道元
quoteCn: 坐禅，是通往内心宁静的唯一入口。
quoteEn: Zazen is the gate to peace

author: 手塚治虫
quoteCn: 我们之所以需要故事，是为了在那些跌宕起伏里，看见自己的影子，确认自己是谁。
quoteEn: Humans need stories to know who they are.

author: 夏目漱石
quoteCn: 我们每个人，都活在自己映照出的世界里。
quoteEn: We all live in our own mirrors.

author: 道元
quoteCn: 放下身心，放下身心。让一切执念随风而逝，回归本真。
quoteEn: Let go of body and mind, let go of body and mind.

author: 安部公房
quoteCn: 沙漠，是人类终于明白自己身处荒芜之地。
quoteEn: The desert is a place for humans to know they are in the desert.

author: 道元
quoteCn: 佛法，亦随光阴流转，因缘际会，而展露不同面貌。
quoteEn: The Buddhist teachings are dependent on time and circumstance.

author: 石川啄木
quoteCn: 无生命的沙，握得越紧，越从指缝间无声滑落，徒留一份空寂的悲哀。
quoteEn: The sorrow of lifeless sand, it slips through my fingers when I grasp it

author: 石川啄木
quoteCn: 那些朋友们都熠熠生辉的日子，我只愿买束花，与你共赏，享受这寻常的温柔。
quoteEn: On days when all my friends seem greater than I, I buy flowers and enjoy them with my wife

author: 九鬼周造
quoteCn: 美，是存在本身的光芒。
quoteEn: Beauty is the light of existence.

author: 松尾芭蕉
quoteCn: 花云深处，钟声隐约传来，是上野的，还是浅草的呢？这般朦胧，这般不确定，却又如此诗意。
quoteEn: The cherry blossoms are in the clouds, is the bell from Ueno or Asakusa?

author: 松尾芭蕉
quoteCn: 初夏的骤雨，急促汇聚，涌入最上川。生命啊，不也如此，无常聚散，奔流向前。
quoteEn: The early summer rains gather swiftly, Mogami River

author: 安部公房
quoteCn: 孤独，是人类灵魂深处最不为人知的角落，它在那里，静默地生长。
quoteEn: Loneliness exists in the deepest part of a human being.

author: 与谢野晶子
quoteCn: 若世间无樱花，春日的心绪，或许能更安然。
quoteEn: If sakura did not exist in this world, spring's heart would be more at ease

author: 九鬼周造
quoteCn: “粹”（Iki）由魅惑、风骨与淡然三要素构成。
quoteEn: "Iki" consists of three elements charm, spirit, and resignation.

author: 与谢野晶子
quoteCn: 我独自站在世界的尽头，风，无情地拍打着我。
quoteEn: I stand alone at the edge of the world, buffeted by the wind

author: 石川啄木
quoteCn: 日复一日，我劳作不息，可生活啊，却未曾对我温柔以待。我只是，怔怔地望着这双磨砺的双手。
quoteEn: Though I work and work, my life does not become any easier; I merely gaze at my hands.

author: 松尾芭蕉
quoteCn: 旅途病困，梦魂萦绕荒芜原野。
quoteEn: Sick on my journey, my dreams circle around a desolate field

author: 松尾芭蕉
quoteCn: 初冬细雨，连山间的猿猴，也渴望一件小小的蓑衣。
quoteEn: The first winter rain, even monkeys desire a small cloak

author: 道元
quoteCn: 若生死之中有佛性，那便再无生死可言。
quoteEn: If there is Buddha in life and death, there is no life and death.

author: 松尾芭蕉
quoteCn: 夏草萋萋，是那些将士们未竟之梦的痕迹啊。
quoteEn: The summer grass, the traces of soldiers' dreams

author: 安部公房
quoteCn: 现实，不过是梦境投下的那道幽影。
quoteEn: Reality is the shadow of a dream.

author: 松尾芭蕉
quoteCn: 此路无人行，秋意渐深，暮色苍茫。
quoteEn: This path, no one walks on it, autumn evening

author: 托勒密
quoteCn: 星辰的低语，并非命运的枷锁，而是温柔的指引，轻柔地拨动你心弦的方向。
quoteEn: The influence of the stars is not compelling, but inclining.

author: 松尾芭蕉
quoteCn: 波涛汹涌，天河横亘佐渡。这无垠的宇宙，映照着人世的孤寂与浩渺。
quoteEn: The rough sea, the heavenly river stretches across Sado.

author: 松尾芭蕉
quoteCn: 古池寂寂，蛙声忽起，水波轻漾，心湖微澜。
quoteEn: Old pond; a frog jumps in—sound of water

author: 瑞安·霍利迪
quoteCn: 世事无常，唯一能确信的，是总有不测风云。而我们唯一能做的，便是以洞察与预见，温柔地化解那些突如其来的波澜。
quoteEn: The only guarantee, ever, is that things will go wrong. The only thing we can use to mitigate this is anticipation.

author: 瑞安·霍利迪
quoteCn: 活在当下，别让那些或虚或实的未来幻象，吞噬了此刻的安宁。
quoteEn: Focus on the moment, not the monsters that may or may not be up ahead.

author: 与谢野晶子
quoteCn: 青春热血奔涌，唯我，独自燃烧。
quoteEn: The young blood surges, and I alone burn

author: 罗伯特·约翰逊
quoteCn: 我伫立在命运的歧路口，伸出手，渴望能搭上那一程未知的便车。
quoteEn: I was standing at the crossroads, tried to flag a ride.

author: 瑞安·霍利迪
quoteCn: 热爱命运——不只是被动接受已然发生的一切，而是张开双臂去拥抱它，视其为生命馈赠的美好、必然，是宏大叙事中不可或缺的一笔。
quoteEn: Amor fati—the love of fate. To not only accept what happens but to embrace it, to see it as good, as necessary, as part of a larger plan.

author: 斯科特·亚当斯
quoteCn: 创造力，是允许自己跌跌撞撞；而艺术，是懂得珍藏那些不完美的印记。
quoteEn: Creativity is allowing yourself to make mistakes. Art is knowing which ones to keep.

author: 瑞安·霍利迪
quoteCn: 静默，是万物的钥匙。它是思绪流转间的留白，音符跌宕后的寂静，亦是风暴来临前的，那份深邃的宁和。
quoteEn: Stillness is the key to everything. It is the space between thoughts, the silence between notes, the calm before the storm.

author: 瑞安·霍利迪
quoteCn: 那些阻碍你前行的，恰恰是推动你前进的力量。你所面对的困境，最终会成为你通往未来的道路。
quoteEn: The impediment to action advances action. What stands in the way becomes the way.

author: 史蒂芬·约翰逊
quoteCn: 那『邻近的可能』，是未来投下的幽影，轻抚着此刻的边缘，它低语着，所有当下得以自我重塑的温柔路径。
quoteEn: The adjacent possible is a kind of shadow future, hovering on the edges of the present state of things, a map of all the ways in which the present can reinvent itself.

author: 蒂姆·厄本
quoteCn: 拖延，从来都不是与时间赛跑的困境，而是我们与内心情绪博弈的挣扎。
quoteEn: Procrastination is not a time management problem. It’s an emotion management problem.

author: 蒂姆·厄本
quoteCn: 唯有那份深切的恐慌，才能将沉溺于即时快感的猴子驱逐，迫使我们正视现实。
quoteEn: The Panic Monster is the only thing that can scare the Instant Gratification Monkey away.

author: 史蒂芬·约翰逊
quoteCn: 错误，并非只是通往卓越的必经之痛。它更是一束光，照亮你走出安逸窠臼的全新路径。
quoteEn: Error is not simply a phase you have to suffer through on the way to genius. Error often creates a path that leads you out of your comfortable assumptions.

author: 蒂姆·厄本
quoteCn: 生命，是由无数细微的奇迹串联而成。请放慢脚步，用心去感受它们。
quoteEn: Life is a series of thousands of tiny miracles. Notice them.

author: 瑞安·霍利迪
quoteCn: 真正的谦逊，并非自我贬低，而是将“我”置于更小的位置，让世界更大。
quoteEn: True humility is not thinking less of yourself; it is thinking of yourself less.

author: 泰勒·科文
quoteCn: 世界在悄然向好，可我们却深陷于前所未有的问题感知中，心绪难平。
quoteEn: The world is getting better, but it doesn’t feel that way because we’re more aware of problems than ever before.

author: 安藤忠雄
quoteCn: 建筑，不止是空间的凝固，更是时间的流淌。它关乎我们如何在这流逝中，与空间共情，与记忆相拥。
quoteEn: Architecture is not about space but about time. It is about how people experience the space over time.

author: 宫崎 駿
quoteCn: 动画，并非现实的复刻，而是我们内心深处，那片超越现实的奇境。
quoteEn: Creating animation is not about depicting reality, but about portraying a world beyond reality.

author: 宫崎 駿
quoteCn: 我厌恶战争与暴力，却无法对它们视而不见。
quoteEn: I dislike depicting war and violence. However, I cannot ignore them.

author: 安藤忠雄
quoteCn: 光，万物之源。它轻抚世间万物，赋予它们独一无二的表情与生命。
quoteEn: Light is the origin of all being. Striking the surface of things, light grants them an expression.

author: 宫崎 駿
quoteCn: 动画，是筑梦的舟楫，它并非带你逃离此岸，而是助你鼓足勇气，直面生活的惊涛骇浪。
quoteEn: Animation is a tool for dreaming, not to escape reality, but to confront it.

author: 宫崎 駿
quoteCn: 孩子们的心灵，远比我们大人所想的更为澄澈与敏锐。请务必，不要对他们撒谎。
quoteEn: Children are wiser and more sensitive than adults think. You must not lie to them.

author: 黑泽明
quoteCn: 当人沉浸在梦境之中，他便是无拘无束的天才。
quoteEn: Man is a genius when he is dreaming.

author: 大江健三郎
quoteCn: 我相信，在人类存在的深处，绝望与希望始终交织，形成一种永恒的张力。
quoteEn: I believe that what lies at the core of human existence is the tension between despair and hope.

author: 黑泽明
quoteCn: 身为创作者，意味着你永远无法对世界的真相视而不见。
quoteEn: To be an artist means never to avert your eyes.

author: 宫崎 駿
quoteCn: 我乐于描绘人性的脆弱与愚钝，因为那正是我们之所以为人的，最真实也最动人的底色。
quoteEn: I enjoy depicting human weakness and foolishness, for that is what it means to be human.

author: 黑泽明
quoteCn: 艺术家的使命，是凝视，而非转开目光。
quoteEn: The role of the artist is to not look away.

author: 黑泽明
quoteCn: 这世界癫狂，唯有癫狂者，才得清明。
quoteEn: In a mad world, only the mad are sane.

author: 空海
quoteCn: 此身即佛，当下圆满。
quoteEn: Attaining Buddhahood in this very body

author: 大江健三郎
quoteCn: 我深信，作家的使命，是去承载人类的苦痛，并将那份沉重，化为笔尖流淌的文字。
quoteEn: I believe that a writer's role is to share human suffering and put it into words.

author: 大江健三郎
quoteCn: 我必须直面过往，才能真正相信人类的未来。
quoteEn: I must confront the past in order to believe in the future of humanity.

author: 空海
quoteCn: 真理不远，它就在你我心间。
quoteEn: The Dharma is not far away; it is close within the heart.

author: 空海
quoteCn: 心，乃万物之所生，亦是万象之所归。它既是幻象的源头，也是觉醒的起点。
quoteEn: The mind is the source of all things

author: 空海
quoteCn: 众生皆有佛性，那份本自具足的清净与智慧，从未离去。
quoteEn: All beings possess Buddha nature

author: 空海
quoteCn: 佛法，不在远方，就在你那颗跳动的心里，它一直都在，等待你温柔地发现。
quoteEn: The Buddha's law is within your own heart

author: 山本耀司
quoteCn: 完美，在我眼中，是种丑陋。我更愿在人造之物中，窥见那些不加掩饰的伤痕、未竟的失败、自然的无序，以及独特的扭曲。
quoteEn: I think perfection is ugly. Somewhere in the things humans make, I want to see scars, failure, disorder, distortion.

author: 寺山修司
quoteCn: 我以梦境，对抗现实的荒芜。
quoteEn: I dream to deny reality.

author: 空海
quoteCn: 万物归于一心，万象皆由心生。这不仅是宇宙的法则，更是我们内在平静的源泉。
quoteEn: All phenomena return to one mind

author: 山本耀司
quoteCn: 黑色，谦逊与傲慢并存。它慵懒随性，却又深邃神秘。而它最想表达的，或许是这样一种姿态：'我自安然，勿扰我清净。'
quoteEn: Black is modest and arrogant at the same time. Black is lazy and easy—but mysterious. But above all, black says this: 'I don’t bother you—don’t bother me.'

author: 山本耀司
quoteCn: 你越是深入世界，越会领悟到自身的微不足道。正因如此，我才始终选择谦卑。
quoteEn: The more you are exposed to the world, the more you realize that you are nothing. That’s why I always try to stay humble.

author: 寺山修司
quoteCn: 电影，是那超越现实，触及灵魂深处的梦境。
quoteEn: Movies are a dream that surpasses reality.

author: 寺山修司
quoteCn: 每一次启程，都是为了与未知的自己相遇。
quoteEn: One travels to know who they are.

author: 寺山修司
quoteCn: 言语，有时是我们为现实戴上的，那层欲盖弥彰的面具。
quoteEn: Words are a mask to hide reality.

author: 寺山修司
quoteCn: 我以未来的笔触，抹去过往的痕迹。
quoteEn: I create the future to forget the past.

author: 寺山修司
quoteCn: 唯有梦境，能让我们挣脱现实的桎梏，抵达彼岸。
quoteEn: Dreams are the only way to transcend reality.

author: 寺山修司
quoteCn: 艺术，是凿开现实壁垒的利刃，是灵魂挣脱桎梏的呐喊。
quoteEn: Art is a weapon to break reality.

author: 寺山修司
quoteCn: 我以诗歌为刃，划破现实的表象，探寻其下涌动的真实。
quoteEn: I write poetry to break reality.

author: 寺山修司
quoteCn: 剧场，是温柔地拆解现实的幻梦之地。
quoteEn: The theater is a device to destroy reality.

author: 岡本太郎
quoteCn: 美，并非安于和谐，而是在矛盾中绽放其独特的魅力。
quoteEn: Beauty lies not in harmony, but in contradiction.

author: 岡本太郎
quoteCn: 艺术，是灵魂深处那一声不甘沉寂的呐喊。
quoteEn: Art is the cry of the human soul.

author: 富野由悠季
quoteCn: 人类的宿命似乎是周而复始的战火，但正是在这无尽的循环中，我们才更要竭力去寻觅那微弱却不灭的希望之光。
quoteEn: Humans repeat wars. However, we must find hope within them.

author: 富野由悠季
quoteCn: 正是因为残缺，我们才得以向内生长，绽放独一无二的生命之花。
quoteEn: Human beings can grow precisely because they are imperfect.

author: 宇多田光
quoteCn: 我并非生来完美，无论是作为人还是艺术家。然而，正是这份不完美，让我得以与你我相连，心意相通。
quoteEn: I am not a perfect person, nor am I a perfect artist. But I believe it is because I am not perfect that I can connect with people.

author: 寺山修司
quoteCn: 诗歌，是挣脱文字牢笼的飞翔，是灵魂对既定边界的温柔反叛。
quoteEn: Poetry is an escape from the prison of words.

author: 宇多田光
quoteCn: 对我而言，音乐，它诞生于比语言更幽微的深处。它是那无以言表的情绪，最温柔也最直接的摆渡。
quoteEn: Music comes from a much deeper place for me than words. It is a means to convey emotions that cannot be expressed in words.

author: 德川家康
quoteCn: 人生在世，犹如肩负重担，跋涉于漫漫长路。每一步都应沉稳，切莫急躁，方能抵达远方。
quoteEn: A person's life is like carrying a heavy load down a long road. One should not rush.

author: 隈研吾
quoteCn: 微小并非束缚，它是建筑中孕育亲密与温暖的契机。
quoteEn: Smallness is not a limitation; it is an opportunity to create intimacy and warmth in architecture.

author: 隈研吾
quoteCn: 建筑并非是矗立的丰碑，而是能让人心安、灵魂归属的栖所。
quoteEn: Architecture is not about creating monuments, but about creating spaces where people can feel at home.

author: 隈研吾
quoteCn: 木，不只是一种材料，它是有生命的呼吸，将我们与森林的灵魂、大地的脉搏温柔相连。
quoteEn: Wood is not just a material; it is a living thing that connects us to the forest and to the earth.

author: 亲鸾
quoteCn: 念佛，是为众生，而非为一己。它超越小我，是与宇宙深处的慈悲共振。
quoteEn: Nembutsu is for the practitioner, but not for the sake of the practitioner.

author: 铃木大拙
quoteCn: 初学者的心，是万象更新的沃土；而专家的心，却常囿于既定的藩篱。
quoteEn: In the beginner's mind there are many possibilities, but in the expert's mind there are few.

author: 铃木大拙
quoteCn: 禅的真谛，即是生命的真谛。生命，在于活出当下，在于行动，而非仅仅沉溺于思虑。
quoteEn: The truth of Zen is the truth of life, and life means to live, to move, to act, not to reflect.

author: 亲鸾
quoteCn: 那些被欲望重重缠绕的迷惘灵魂啊，终将一次次回到这生死流转的尘世。
quoteEn: Befuddled beings, laden with desires, return to the house of life and death.

author: 西田幾多郎
quoteCn: 真正的自我，恰恰在超越小我执念的那一刻，悄然显现。
quoteEn: The true self is found in that which transcends the self.

author: 铃木大拙
quoteCn: 禅，是洞悉自我本源的艺术，它轻柔地指引着，从无形的束缚走向心灵的辽阔与自由。
quoteEn: Zen is the art of seeing into the nature of one's own being, and it points the way from bondage to freedom.

author: 铃木大拙
quoteCn: 禅，是人之本心。它深信，那份内在的纯粹与良善，从未离去。
quoteEn: Zen is the spirit of a man. Zen believes in its inner purity and goodness.

author: 铃木大拙
quoteCn: 禅，不是心潮澎湃的狂喜，而是将心安住于每一个寻常的日常。
quoteEn: Zen is not some kind of excitement, but concentration on our usual everyday routine.

author: 西田幾多郎
quoteCn: 在绝对的虚无中，真正的自由才得以破茧而出。
quoteEn: In absolute nothingness, true freedom is born.

author: 铃木大拙
quoteCn: 我们赖以生存的那个“自我”的硬壳啊，是生命中最难挣脱的束缚。
quoteEn: The ego-shell in which we live is the hardest thing to outgrow.

author: 和辻哲郎
quoteCn: 我们，不过是时间与空间交织的丝线，在无尽的网中浮沉。
quoteEn: The existence of human beings lies within the web woven by time and space.

author: 小津安二郎
quoteCn: 我拍电影，从不奢望教导谁。我只是想，把生活本来的样子，温柔地摊开给你看。
quoteEn: I don't think about teaching the audience anything when I make a movie. I just want to show life as it is.

author: 小津安二郎
quoteCn: 我想通过电影，去触碰那份潜藏在喧嚣之下的，宁静而又深刻的真实。
quoteEn: I want to explore the quiet truth by making films.

author: 小津安二郎
quoteCn: 我愿以电影为笔，描摹生命中那份交织着的美丽与哀伤。
quoteEn: I want to express the beauty and sadness of life through making films.

author: 小津安二郎
quoteCn: 电影，不过是生活碎片的温柔凝视。
quoteEn: Movies are fragments of life.

author: 井上靖
quoteCn: 小说，是探触人心最深处幽微的径道。
quoteEn: Novels are a means to portray what lies deep within the human heart.

author: 遠藤周作
quoteCn: 人性的底色是脆弱，而正是这份坦然的接纳，才让我们得以触碰那份超越尘世的爱意。
quoteEn: Human beings are weak. However, acknowledging that weakness is the first step to experiencing God's love.

author: 遠藤周作
quoteCn: 信仰并非寻得终极答案，而是在无尽的追问中，找到生命的意义与方向。
quoteEn: Faith is not about finding answers, but about continuing to ask questions.

author: 遠藤周作
quoteCn: 神明并非无言，只是我们凡人的呼唤，太过微弱，难以抵达。
quoteEn: God is not silent; it is that human voices are too weak.

author: 井上靖
quoteCn: 历史的螺旋，不过是人性的回音，周而复始，未曾更改。
quoteEn: History is said to repeat itself because human nature does not change.

author: 遠藤周作
quoteCn: 神明偏爱人类的脆弱，因为那份脆弱，恰是人性的本真。
quoteEn: God loves the weakness of humans, for weakness is the truth of humanity.

author: 遠藤周作
quoteCn: 人类的苦难，在神性的静默中，才显露出它深邃的意义。
quoteEn: The suffering of human beings has meaning in the silence of God.

author: 遠藤周作
quoteCn: 神明降世为人，只为与我们共尝人间的苦楚。
quoteEn: God became human to share in the suffering of mankind.

author: 遠藤周作
quoteCn: 信仰并非是去相信神的存在，而是去相信，神也同样相信着你。
quoteEn: Faith is not believing in God, but believing that God believes in you.

author: 遠藤周作
quoteCn: 我们并非苦苦寻觅神祇，而是神祇在温柔地叩响我们的心门。
quoteEn: Humans do not seek God; rather, God seeks humans.

author: 川端 康成
quoteCn: 西方的光芒太过炽烈，灼伤了日本深邃的幽暗。
quoteEn: The light of the West is too bright, and it has destroyed the darkness of Japan.

author: 川端 康成
quoteCn: 美，总是在生命消逝的边缘，绽放出最动人的光华。
quoteEn: Beauty always exists at the cost of life.

author: 遠藤周作
quoteCn: 人性的脆弱，是通往神性之爱的唯一门径。
quoteEn: The weakness of humanity is the only door to accept God's love.

author: 川端 康成
quoteCn: 人心，总在矛盾的潮汐中浮沉。
quoteEn: The human heart always lives in contradiction.

author: 川端 康成
quoteCn: 爱，是温柔地拥抱对方的残缺。
quoteEn: Love is loving the flaws of the other person.

author: 川端 康成
quoteCn: 艺术家，生来便与孤独为伴，那份深邃的寂寥，是创作的源泉，亦是灵魂的宿命。
quoteEn: The artist is always lonely.

author: 草间弥生
quoteCn: 波点，是通向无垠的门径。当我们以波点消融自然与肉身，我们便融入了周遭万物的合一之中，成为那无尽整体的一部分。
quoteEn: Polka dots are a way to infinity. When we obliterate nature and our bodies with polka dots, we become part of the unity of our environment.

author: 草间弥生
quoteCn: 我日复一日地与痛苦、焦虑和恐惧搏斗，而我寻觅到的唯一能疗愈我心疾的方法，唯有持续不辍地创作。
quoteEn: I fight pain, anxiety, and fear every day, and the only method I have found that relieves my illness is to keep creating art.

author: 高村光太郎
quoteCn: 爱，是万物的拥抱，是所有的宽恕。
quoteEn: Love envelops everything. Love forgives all.

author: 川端 康成
quoteCn: 日本人，总能在幽微的暗影中，寻得一缕至美。
quoteEn: Japanese people find beauty in darkness.

author: 草间弥生
quoteCn: 艺术，是我思想与情感唯一的出口，它即是我生命本身。
quoteEn: Art is the only way I can express my thoughts and feelings. It is my life.

author: 草间弥生
quoteCn: 我的艺术，源自我独见的幻象。那些如影随形、缠绕不休的幻觉与执念，被我倾注于雕塑与画作之中，成为我与世界对话的独特语言。
quoteEn: My art originates from hallucinations only I can see. I translate the hallucinations and obsessional images that plague me into sculptures and paintings.

author: 杉本博司
quoteCn: 我试图在有限的方寸之间，捕捉那永恒不息的无限。
quoteEn: I seek to capture the infinite within the finite frame of a photograph.

author: 杉本博司
quoteCn: 摄影，是时间的一场温柔冻结，让那些转瞬即逝的微光，得以永恒地栖息。
quoteEn: Photography is a way of freezing time, of making the ephemeral eternal.

author: 高村光太郎
quoteCn: 真正的艺术，注定是一场孤独的修行。
quoteEn: True art is always lonely.

author: 杉本博司
quoteCn: 艺术并非凭空创造，而是温柔地唤醒那些一直都在，却被我们遗忘的永恒。
quoteEn: Art is not about creating something new, but about rediscovering what has always been there.

author: 杉本博司
quoteCn: 我的摄影，是一场逆行的时光之旅。我定格那些已然消逝的瞬间，它们却在影像里，以另一种永恒的姿态，静默地呼吸。
quoteEn: My photography is a form of time travel. I capture moments that no longer exist, yet they persist in the image.

author: 爱德华·O·威尔逊
quoteCn: 我们身披旧石器时代的情感，被中世纪的制度束缚，却手握神祇般的技术。这，便是人类最深层的困境。
quoteEn: The real problem of humanity is the following: we have paleolithic emotions; medieval institutions; and god-like technology.

author: 杉本博司
quoteCn: 那些过往，即便无形无相，也早已刻入我的作品，成为我生命的一部分。
quoteEn: The past is always present in my work, even if it is invisible to the eye.

author: 杉本博司
quoteCn: 光，是摄影的骨肉，而时间，才是它不朽的灵魂。
quoteEn: Light is the essence of photography, and time is its soul.

author: 荒木经惟
quoteCn: 每一张照片，都是记忆在时间洪流中，不期而遇的碎片。
quoteEn: Photographs are fragments of memory.

author: 高村光太郎
quoteCn: 诗，是心底最深处的呐喊。而文字，则为这份呐喊塑形，让无声的痛与爱得以被听见。
quoteEn: Poetry is the cry of the heart. Words give that cry form.

author: 荒木经惟
quoteCn: 摄影，是抵御消逝的温柔反抗。
quoteEn: Photography is a resistance to death.

author: 高村光太郎
quoteCn: 美，自苦难深处破茧而出。
quoteEn: Beauty is born from suffering.

author: 约翰·梅纳德·凯恩斯
quoteCn: 所谓“长远”，不过是一场宏大的幻象，它模糊了此刻的真切。因为，在那个遥远的“长远”里，我们都已归于尘土。
quoteEn: The long run is a misleading guide to current affairs. In the long run we are all dead.

author: 杉本博司
quoteCn: 每帧光影皆是记忆的定格，然而，并非所有记忆都能被光影捕捉，它们深藏于心，无形却永恒。
quoteEn: Every photograph is a memory, but not all memories are photographs.

author: 约翰·凯恩斯·加尔布雷思
quoteCn: 面对改变心意，抑或证明无需改变的抉择，几乎所有人都会不遗余力地去证明后者。
quoteEn: Faced with the choice between changing one's mind and proving that there is no need to do so, almost everyone gets busy on the proof.

author: 约翰·梅纳德·凯恩斯
quoteCn: 言语，当它带着些许不羁，便成了思想对那些沉睡心灵的温柔冲击。
quoteEn: Words ought to be a little wild, for they are the assault of thoughts on the unthinking.

author: 约翰·弥尔顿
quoteCn: 宁愿在炼狱中称王，也不愿在天堂里为奴。
quoteEn: Better to reign in Hell than serve in Heaven.

author: 杉本博司
quoteCn: 摄影，是可见与不可见的耳语，是已知与未知的深邃对谈。它捕捉的不仅是光影，更是那些潜藏在表象之下，触动灵魂的秘密。
quoteEn: Photography is a dialogue between the seen and the unseen, the known and the unknown.

author: 约翰·弥尔顿
quoteCn: 有时，孤独是最好的慰藉。
quoteEn: Solitude sometimes is best society.

author: 约翰·纳什
quoteCn: 我此生最重要的发现，唯有在爱的神秘算式中，逻辑与理性才得以显现其真谛。
quoteEn: I have made the most important discovery of my life. It's only in the mysterious equations of love that any logic or reasons can be found.

author: 约翰·弥尔顿
quoteCn: 声名，是那清澈灵魂的鞭策（高贵心智最后的执念），它让人轻视欢愉，甘愿躬耕于漫长岁月。
quoteEn: Fame is the spur that the clear spirit doth raise (That last infirmity of noble mind) To scorn delights, and live laborious days.

author: 约瑟夫·坎贝尔
quoteCn: 放下你曾紧握的剧本，才能拥抱命运为你铺陈的篇章。
quoteEn: We must let go of the life we have planned, so as to accept the one that is waiting for us.

author: 约翰·弥尔顿
quoteCn: 邪念，如风过境，可潜入神明或凡人的心湖，来去无痕，不曾留下半分污点或责难。它只是来了，又走了，而你，依然是你。
quoteEn: Evil into the mind of god or man may come and go, so unapproved, and leave no spot or blame behind.

author: 约瑟夫·坎贝尔
quoteCn: 生命本无意义，意义由我们每个人赋予。当你就是答案本身，又何必向外追寻？
quoteEn: Life has no meaning. Each of us has meaning and we bring it to life. It is a waste to be asking the question when you are the answer.

author: 路德维希·范·贝多芬
quoteCn: 我要紧紧扼住命运的咽喉，绝不让它将我彻底击垮或弯折。
quoteEn: I will seize fate by the throat; it shall not bend or crush me completely.

author: 约翰·斯图亚特·密尔
quoteCn: 在自我身心之上，个体是至高无上的主宰。
quoteEn: Over himself, over his own body and mind, the individual is sovereign.

author: 约翰·斯图亚特·密尔
quoteCn: 那些未经深思熟虑便接受的所谓真理，远不如一个独立思考者，即便他犯了错，所带来的领悟更深刻。因为真正的成长，总在自我探索与试错的阵痛中悄然发生。
quoteEn: Truth gains more even by the errors of one who, with due study and preparation, thinks for himself, than by the true opinions of those who only hold them because they do not suffer themselves to think.

author: 约翰·弥尔顿
quoteCn: 漫漫长路，荆棘载途，方能从炼狱深渊，攀援至光明彼岸。
quoteEn: Long is the way and hard, that out of Hell leads up to light.

author: 巴勃罗·毕加索
quoteCn: 艺术，是那以谎言之名，却让我们洞悉真实面貌的奇迹。
quoteEn: Art is a lie that makes us realize the truth.

author: 巴勃罗·毕加索
quoteCn: 画笔轻触，墨迹流淌，那是我无声的日记，记录着不为人知的心事与时光。
quoteEn: Painting is just another way of keeping a diary.

author: 理查德·瓦格纳
quoteCn: 生命，一场注定的错位；死亡，是灵魂归返真境的安宁。
quoteEn: Life is an error, and death is the return to truth.

author: 巴勃罗·毕加索
quoteCn: 你所能构想的一切，都已在某种维度真实存在。
quoteEn: Everything you can imagine is real.

author: 巴勃罗·毕加索
quoteCn: 艺术，拂去灵魂上日常的尘埃。
quoteEn: Art washes away from the soul the dust of everyday life.

author: 约瑟夫·坎贝尔
quoteCn: 你曾跌跌撞撞的地方，藏着你最深处的宝藏。
quoteEn: Where you stumble, there lies your treasure.

author: 理查德·瓦格纳
quoteCn: 艺术，是灵魂的避难所，让人得以卸下尘世的重负，片刻喘息。
quoteEn: Art is meant to free man from the burdens of life.

author: 约瑟夫·坎贝尔
quoteCn: 神话是众生共有的梦境，而梦境，则是我们每个人独有的神话。
quoteEn: Myths are public dreams, dreams are private myths.

author: 萨尔瓦多·达利
quoteCn: 每个清晨，当我从睡梦中醒来，我再次沉浸于一种至高无上的喜悦——那便是，我依然是我，萨尔瓦多·达利。
quoteEn: Each morning when I awake, I experience again a supreme pleasure—that of being Salvador Dalí.

author: 文森特·范·戈 Gogh
quoteCn: 我寻觅，我挣扎，我将身心全然交付于此。
quoteEn: I am seeking, I am striving, I am in it with all my heart.

author: 萨尔瓦多·达利
quoteCn: 六岁那年，我梦想成为一名厨师；七岁时，我渴望成为拿破仑。自此以后，我的野心便如潮水般，汹涌澎湃，永无止境。
quoteEn: At the age of six I wanted to be a cook. At seven I wanted to be Napoleon. And my ambition has been growing steadily ever since.

author: 文森特·范·戈 Gogh
quoteCn: 我越是沉思，越是明白，世间最真挚的艺术，莫过于去爱人。
quoteEn: The more I think about it, the more I realize there is nothing more truly artistic than to love people.

author: 文森特·范·戈 Gogh
quoteCn: 若你心底传来低语：'你画不出色彩'，那么，请你务必拿起画笔，让那质疑之声，在笔触间消散无形。
quoteEn: If you hear a voice within you say 'you cannot paint,' then by all means paint, and that voice will be silenced.

author: 理查德·瓦格纳
quoteCn: 爱，是所有艺术的源头活水，滋养着灵魂深处最纯粹的创造。
quoteEn: Love is the source of all art.

author: 蒂姆·伯纳斯-李
quoteCn: 那些在屏幕前忘却时间的人啊，他们懂得沉浸于梦想的魔力，也深知将这魔力化为现实的冲动，甚至为此，甘愿错过一顿午餐的寻常。
quoteEn: Anyone who has lost track of time when using a computer knows the propensity to dream, the urge to make dreams come true, and the tendency to miss lunch.

author: 文森特·范·戈 Gogh
quoteCn: 我将心魂倾注于我的创作，却也因此，迷失了自我。
quoteEn: I put my heart and my soul into my work, and have lost my mind in the process.

author: 萨尔瓦多·达利
quoteCn: 超现实主义，它摧毁的并非一切，而是那些禁锢我们心眼、束缚我们想象的无形枷锁。
quoteEn: Surrealism is destructive, but it destroys only what it considers to be shackles limiting our vision.

author: 伊曼努尔·康德
quoteCn: 道德并非指引我们如何追逐短暂的欢愉，而是教我们如何雕琢内在，成为值得被幸福温柔以待的灵魂。
quoteEn: Morality is not the doctrine of how we may make ourselves happy, but how we may make ourselves worthy of happiness.

author: 文森特·范·戈 Gogh
quoteCn: 若无一试的孤勇，生命将是何等苍白？
quoteEn: What would life be if we had no courage to attempt anything?

author: 弗里德里希·尼采
quoteCn: 神已逝去。神仍旧长眠。而我们，正是弑神者。
quoteEn: God is dead. God remains dead. And we have killed him.

author: 弗里德里希·尼采
quoteCn: 你心中须藏有混沌，方能孕育出那颗舞动的星辰。
quoteEn: You must have chaos within you to give birth to a dancing star.

author: 路德维希·范·贝多芬
quoteCn: 音乐，是灵魂与肉身之间，那温柔的摆渡人。
quoteEn: Music is the mediator between the spiritual and the sensual life.

author: 让-保罗·萨特
quoteCn: 人被判处自由，一旦被掷入这世间，便无从逃避选择的重负。
quoteEn: "Man is condemned to be free; because once thrown into the world, he is forced to choose."

author: 伯特兰·拉塞尔
quoteCn: 偶尔停下来，审视那些你曾深信不疑的理所当然，这本身就是一种心灵的呼吸与清醒。
quoteEn: "In all affairs it's a healthy thing now and then to hang a question mark on the things you have long taken for granted."

author: 让·皮亚杰
quoteCn: 玩耍，是万物新生、灵感涌现的秘密钥匙。
quoteEn: Play is the answer to how anything new comes about.

author: 让-保罗·萨特
quoteCn: 人被判处自由，一旦被抛掷于世，便无从逃避选择的重负。
quoteEn: Man is condemned to be free; because once thrown into the world, he is forced to choose.

author: 伯特兰·拉塞尔
quoteCn: 这世间的症结，在于愚者与狂热者总是笃信不疑，而智者，却满怀着无尽的疑虑。
quoteEn: The whole problem with the world is that fools and fanatics are always so certain of themselves, but wiser people so full of doubts.

author: 西格蒙德·弗洛伊德
quoteCn: 类比，或许无法为你拍板定论，却能像一盏暖灯，让你在陌生的迷宫里，找到一丝归属与安然。
quoteEn: Analogies, it is true, decide nothing, but they can make one feel more at home.

author: 卡尔·荣格
quoteCn: 我们戴着面具，扮演着社会期待的角色，却在面具之下，渴望着真实的呼吸。唯有卸下那层伪装，才能与内在的真我相遇，让灵魂自由舒展。
quoteEn: The persona is a social mask that hides our true nature, and it is only by dropping this mask that we can become our true selves.

author: 卡尔·荣格
quoteCn: 真正的觉醒，并非沉溺于光明的幻想，而是勇敢地潜入并照亮你内在的幽暗。
quoteEn: One does not become enlightened by imagining figures of light, but by making the darkness conscious.

author: 卡尔·荣格
quoteCn: 我们并非通过幻想光明而获得启迪，而是通过直面并唤醒内心的幽暗。然而，这番向内探索的旅程，往往令人不适，故而鲜有人问津。
quoteEn: One does not become enlightened by imagining figures of light, but by making the darkness conscious. The latter procedure, however, is disagreeable and therefore not very popular.

author: 西格蒙德·弗洛伊德
quoteCn: 潜意识如浩瀚的夜空，意识只是其中一颗闪烁的星辰，微小却被温柔地拥抱。
quoteEn: The unconscious mind is the larger circle which includes within itself the smaller circle of the conscious mind.

author: 威廉·詹姆斯
quoteCn: 意识之河流淌不息，其所承载的一切，都在永恒的变动中，无常而又生生不息。
quoteEn: The stream of consciousness flows on unbroken, and whatever is carried by it is in a continuous state of change.

author: 让-保罗·萨特
quoteCn: 所谓自欺，不过是向自己撒谎，否认了那份本就属于你的、无可逃避的自由。
quoteEn: Bad faith is a lie to oneself, which consists of denying the reality of one's own freedom.

author: 马尔库斯·奥勒留
quoteCn: 清晨醒来，请记得，能活着、能思考、能呼吸，这本身就是一种恩赐，一种值得被温柔感受的奇迹。
quoteEn: "When you arise in the morning think of what a privilege it is to be alive, to think, to breathe."

author: 塞涅卡
quoteCn: 生命最深重的羁绊，是那份对未来的无尽期盼。它将我们悬置于明日的幻影，却让我们错失了此刻的真实与丰盛。
quoteEn: The greatest obstacle to living is expectancy, which hangs upon tomorrow and loses today.

author: 伊壁鸠鲁
quoteCn: 幸福，不在于你拥有多少，而在于你如何品味你所拥有的一切。
quoteEn: Not what we have, but what we enjoy, constitutes our happiness.

author: 塞涅卡
quoteCn: 并非是困境让我们却步，而是我们的却步，才让困境显得如此难以逾越。
quoteEn: "It is not because things are difficult that we dare not venture. It is because we dare not venture that they are difficult."

author: 爱比克泰德
quoteCn: 困扰你的，从来不是那些发生过的事，而是你对它们的执念和解读。
quoteEn: It is not events that disturb men, but their own opinions about those events.

author: 威廉·詹姆斯
quoteCn: 意识，唯有在蜕变中方能显现其真容；而我们，也唯有在经历那份蜕变时，才得以真正触及并领悟它。
quoteEn: Consciousness does not appear to itself until it has been changed, and it is only by changing that we can know it.

author: 爱比克泰德
quoteCn: 我们所受的苦痛，往往并非源于现实的铁砧，而是来自我们内心那无休止的想象之火。
quoteEn: We suffer more from imagination than from reality.

author: 赫拉克利特
quoteCn: 你的灵魂，是你思想的调色盘。请细细思量，那些与你本性深处和谐共鸣的事物。
quoteEn: The soul is dyed the color of its thoughts. Think about that which is in harmony with your nature.

author: 赫拉克利特
quoteCn: 你无法两次踏入同一条河流，因为河流已非昨日之水，而你，也早已不是彼时的你。
quoteEn: No man ever steps in the same river twice, for it's not the same river and he's not the same man.

author: 马尔库斯·奥勒留
quoteCn: 宇宙永恒流转，而我们的生命，不过是我们心念所塑的模样。
quoteEn: The universe is change; our life is what our thoughts make it.

author: 伯特兰·拉塞尔
quoteCn: 偶尔停下来，对那些你深信不疑、习以为常的一切，轻轻打上一个问号。这不仅是清醒，更是灵魂的深呼吸。
quoteEn: In all affairs it's a healthy thing now and then to hang a question mark on the things you have long taken for granted.

author: 奥古斯丁
quoteCn: 即便我身陷迷途，我依然是我，存在于此。
quoteEn: "If I am mistaken, I exist"

author: 赫拉克利特
quoteCn: 向上攀登的路径，与向下沉沦的路径，本是同一条。生命中的起伏跌宕，皆是旅程的一部分，无所谓高低，无所谓好坏，只是存在。
quoteEn: The way up and the way down are one and the same.

author: 迈蒙尼德斯
quoteCn: 宇宙并非由孤立的碎片组成，它是一个流动的整体，而我们的灵魂，正是这无垠整体中，一息相通的脉动。
quoteEn: The universe is not a collection of distinct objects, but a single, unified whole, and the human soul is a part of this whole.

author: 大卫·休谟
quoteCn: 理性，不过是激情的仆从，它唯一的使命，便是臣服与效忠。它从不奢求扮演其他角色，只为那份炽热而存在。
quoteEn: Reason is, and ought only to be the slave of the passions, and can never pretend to any other office than to serve and obey them.

author: 路德维希·维特根斯坦
quoteCn: 我们总以为自己在探寻事物的本真，却不曾想，我们只是在描画那框定我们视角的边界。
quoteEn: One thinks that one is tracing the outline of the thing's nature over and over again, and one is merely tracing round the frame through which we look at it.

author: 阿尔贝·加缪
quoteCn: 荒诞，生于我们对意义的呼唤，与世界那份无动于衷的沉默，两者相遇的瞬间。
quoteEn: The absurd is born out of this confrontation between the human need and the unreasonable silence of the world.

author: 路德维希·维特根斯坦
quoteCn: 我语言的边界，即我世界的边界。我们所能言说的，框定了我们所能感知的。
quoteEn: The limits of my language are the limits of my world.

author: 路德维希·维特根斯坦
quoteCn: 一幅心像，将我们困锁。我们挣脱不出，因为它深植于我们的言语，而语言，又似乎无休止地，将它复述于我们耳畔。
quoteEn: A picture held us captive. And we could not get outside it, for it lay in our language and language seemed to repeat it to us inexorably.

author: 雅克·德里达
quoteCn: 我只说一种语言，可那语言，却不属于我。
quoteEn: I speak only one language, and it is not my own.

author: 阿尔弗雷德·阿德勒
quoteCn: 你所认为的“正常人”，不过是你还未深究其内心的人。
quoteEn: The only normal people are the ones you don't know very well.

author: 凯伦·霍尼
quoteCn: 神经症并非疾病，它只是我们选择的一种生活姿态。
quoteEn: Neurosis is not a disease, but a way of life.

author: 埃里克·埃里克森
quoteCn: 那些被生命洪流不断重塑的灵魂，才活出了最丰盛的篇章；而那些被我们深沉反思反复打磨的经历，才真正闪耀着最深刻的光芒。
quoteEn: The richest lives are those that are constantly transformed by their experiences, and the richest experiences are those that are constantly being transformed by our reflections on them.

author: 凯伦·霍尼
quoteCn: 那种被世界遗弃、被人群排斥的孤独感，是人类灵魂深处最难以承受的痛楚之一。
quoteEn: The feeling of being isolated, of being an outcast, is one of the most painful experiences a human being can undergo.

author: 约翰·B·华生
quoteCn: 我们大多数的心理困境，都源于我们执着于去适应那个“应该如此”的世界，而非坦然接纳它本来的样子。
quoteEn: Most of our psychological ills come from our attempts to adjust to the world as we think it ought to be, rather than as it is.

author: 亚伯拉罕·马斯洛
quoteCn: 一个人能成为什么，他就必须去成为什么。这股内在的驱动，我们称之为自我实现。
quoteEn: "What a man can be, he must be. This need we may call self-actualization."

author: 卡尔·罗杰斯
quoteCn: 当我全然接纳自我，便从向世界展示虚假面具的重负中，获得了真正的自由。
quoteEn: "When I accept myself, I am freed from the burden of having to present a facade to the world."

author: 罗洛·梅
quoteCn: 心理疗愈的真谛，在于唤醒你内在的自由，而非将你塑造成社会期待的模样，或禁锢于任何既定的思想藩篱。
quoteEn: The purpose of psychotherapy is to set people free, not to make them conform to a particular ideology or to adjust to society.

author: 亚伯拉罕·马斯洛
quoteCn: 人性深处，善意流淌。若以温柔与安稳相待，爱与协作自会如泉涌般回馈。
quoteEn: The fact is that people are good. Give people affection and security, and they will give you love and cooperation.

author: 罗洛·梅
quoteCn: 我们生而为人，注定要在这永恒的困境中挣扎：一边是灵魂对无垠自由的渴望，一边是本能对安稳庇护的渴求。这份撕扯，是生命的底色，也是我们存在的证明。
quoteEn: Human beings are caught in an unavoidable dilemma: we are torn between our desire for freedom and our need for security.

author: 维克多·弗兰克尔
quoteCn: 生命，无论境遇如何，即使在最深重的苦难中，也自有其意义。
quoteEn: Life has meaning under all circumstances, even in the most miserable conditions.

author: 维克多·弗兰克尔
quoteCn: 意义疗法，是向未来借一束光，照亮此刻的脚下，让生命的意义，不再是遥不可及的彼岸，而是当下每一步的践行。
quoteEn: Logotherapy focuses on the future, in order to find meaning, and on the present, in order to realize it.

author: 罗洛·梅
quoteCn: 焦虑，是自由的眩晕，是对眼前无限可能性的深层恐惧。
quoteEn: Anxiety is the dizziness of freedom, the fear of the possibilities that lie before us.

author: 埃里希·弗洛姆
quoteCn: 爱，是意志的抉择，是主动延展自我，去滋养内在的成长，亦或成就他人的绽放。
quoteEn: Love is an act of will, namely the will to extend one's self for the purpose of nurturing one's own growth or the growth of another.

author: 罗洛·梅
quoteCn: 在我们这个时代，勇气的反面并非怯懦，而是随波逐流的盲从。它提醒我们，真正的勇敢，是敢于不与世俗同流合污的清醒。
quoteEn: The opposite of courage in our society is not cowardice, it is conformity.

author: 维克多·弗兰克尔
quoteCn: 世间万物皆可被夺走，唯独一样不能：那是人类最后的自由——在任何境遇中，选择自己的态度，选择自己的路。
quoteEn: Everything can be taken from a man but one thing: the last of the human freedoms—to choose one's attitude in any given set of circumstances, to choose one's own way.

author: 维克多·弗兰克尔
quoteCn: 在评判他人之前，请先诚实地叩问内心：若身处同样的境地，我是否也能免于同样的抉择？
quoteEn: No man should judge unless he asks himself in absolute honesty whether in a similar situation he might not have done the same.

author: 卡尔·罗杰斯
quoteCn: 你我皆是流动的河，生命本就无常。疗愈的意义，不在于将你我定格成某座雕塑，而是温柔地，让这股流淌的生命力，更自由、更丰盛地奔涌。
quoteEn: The person is a fluid, ever-changing process, and the aim of therapy is to enhance this process, not to solidify it into a fixed state.

author: 埃里希·弗洛姆
quoteCn: 一个真正健全的社会，是能温柔承托起每个人真实需求的港湾，而非冷酷地要求我们先变得“正常”，才能被它接纳。它关乎滋养，而非规训。
quoteEn: The sane society is that which corresponds to the needs of man, not that which needs man to be sane.

author: 埃里希·弗洛姆
quoteCn: 我们对自由的畏惧，往往比对自由本身的渴望，更加根深蒂固，也更具力量。
quoteEn: The fear of freedom is stronger than the desire for freedom.

author: 杰罗姆·布鲁纳
quoteCn: 叙事，不只是我们回望过往的路径，更是我们塑造自我与世界的画笔。
quoteEn: Narrative is not just a way of recounting experience, it is a way of constructing it.

author: 杰罗姆·布鲁纳
quoteCn: 你以为的那个“我”，并非一成不变的雕塑，而是一部永不停歇的自传，每一天都在被你重新书写，重新定义。
quoteEn: The self is not a fixed entity, but a narrative construction, constantly being revised and updated.

author: 凯伦·霍尼
quoteCn: 将人类情感硬塞进预设的行为框架，是所有内心挣扎的根源。
quoteEn: The attempt to force human emotions into a predetermined pattern of behavior is the root of all psychological distress.

author: 约翰·博尔比
quoteCn: 与他人的亲密联结，是生命围绕其旋转的轴心。它不仅是支撑，更是我们存在的意义与方向。
quoteEn: Intimate attachments to other human beings are the hub around which a person's life revolves.

author: 菲利普·津巴多
quoteCn: 善恶之间，界限模糊，薄如蝉翼，一念之差，便可逾越。
quoteEn: The line between good and evil is permeable, and it's a very, very thin line.

author: 安东尼奥·达马西奥
quoteCn: 心智并非仅居于大脑一隅，它深植于我们身体的每一寸血肉，与生命同频共振。
quoteEn: The mind is not just embedded in the brain; it is embedded in the whole body.

author: 菲利普·津巴多
quoteCn: 当良善之人被卷入泥沼，人性深处的阴影便会浮现。
quoteEn: When you put good people in bad situations, you get bad behavior.

author: 卡罗尔·吉利根
quoteCn: 未能真正看见他人的存在，未能倾听他们心底的声音，未能设身处地理解他们的生命体验，这本身就是一种深刻的、人性的想象力缺失。
quoteEn: The failure to see the other, to hear their voice, to understand their experience, is a failure of moral imagination.

author: 马丁·塞利格曼
quoteCn: 过往不过是耳边风，未来也只是心头念。唯有此刻，才是你我真切的拥有。
quoteEn: The past is just a story, and the future is just a hypothesis. The present moment is all we have.

author: 阿尔贝·加缪
quoteCn: 我反抗着，所以我存在着。这不仅仅是行动，更是对生命意义的深刻确认。
quoteEn: I rebel, therefore I am.

author: 阿尔贝·加缪
quoteCn: 活着，就是一次次在每个当下，与全新的自己相遇。
quoteEn: To live is to be born at every moment.

author: 亚历山大·索尔仁尼琴
quoteCn: 一天，不过是时间长河里的一瞬。可若能真诚而有意义地活过这一天，它便足以抵过一生的重量。
quoteEn: One day is a small unit of time. But one day lived honestly and meaningfully is an entire life.

author: 亚历山大·索尔仁尼琴
quoteCn: 善恶的界线，不在国界，不在阶级，不在党派，它穿透每个人的心。
quoteEn: The line dividing good and evil passes not between states, nor between classes, nor between parties — it passes through every human heart.

author: 阿尔弗雷德·诺思·怀特海
quoteCn: 历经千帆，最令人心潮澎湃的发现，莫过于我们拥有随时重塑自我的力量。
quoteEn: The greatest discovery of all the ages is that a man can change his mind.

author: 阿利斯泰尔·库克
quoteCn: 我们穷尽一生，都在为那些从未降临的虚妄恐惧所困。
quoteEn: The truth is that most of us spend our time being afraid of things that never happen.

author: 艾米·霍伊
quoteCn: 世间至美，非目所及，非手可触，唯心可感。
quoteEn: The best and most beautiful things in the world cannot be seen or even touched - they must be felt with the heart.

author: 安德鲁·卡内基
quoteCn: 真正的富足，并非拥有多少，而是能从多少执念中解脱。
quoteEn: A man is rich in proportion to the number of things he can afford to let alone.

author: 安德烈·纪德
quoteCn: 最美的征服，莫过于战胜自己。
quoteEn: There is no more beautiful conquest than that of oneself.

author: 安德烈·纪德
quoteCn: 艺术是神与人的共谋，而那份不完美，从来都只属于我们凡人。
quoteEn: Art is a collaboration between God and the artist, and the less bad part is not God's.

author: 安德烈·纪德
quoteCn: 怀疑，是青春无法承受的奢侈品。
quoteEn: Doubt is a luxury that youth cannot afford.

author: 安德烈·纪德
quoteCn: 那些未曾分享的，都将随风而逝，不留痕迹。
quoteEn: Everything that is not shared is lost.

author: 阿尔贝·加缪
quoteCn: 所谓自由，不过是在诸多形式的束缚中，选择你所能承受的那一种。
quoteEn: Freedom is the right to choose between several forms of slavery.

author: 亚历山大·索尔仁尼琴
quoteCn: 我们并非生来就如风中尘埃，无声无息地消散。我们生来，是为了在这世间刻下属于自己的印记。
quoteEn: A person is born not to disappear without a trace, like dust in the wind. A person is born to leave a mark.

author: 阿那克萨哥拉
quoteCn: 万物本为一体，无限且合一。它们既渺小又浩瀚。正因万物交织共存，个体便无从显现，因为没有一物能脱离整体而独立存在，一切都融于那无尽的'全'之中。
quoteEn: All things were together, infinite and one. For they were both small and many. And since all things were together, nothing appeared, because nothing existed apart from the other, but all was in the All.

author: 阿瑟·爱丁顿
quoteCn: 浩瀚宇宙，不过是神祇心头一闪的意念。
quoteEn: The universe is a thought in the mind of God.

author: 阿里斯托芬
quoteCn: 人啊，即便身陷囹圄，也终将以其人之道，行尽人间百态。
quoteEn: A wretched man, being a man, does all things human.

author: 阿图尔·叔本华
quoteCn: 我们总以为，自己眼之所及，便是世界的全部。殊不知，那不过是心之囚笼的边界。
quoteEn: Every man takes the limits of his own field of vision for the limits of the world.

author: 阿图尔·叔本华
quoteCn: 生命如钟摆，在痛苦与无聊之间，永恒地来回摆荡。
quoteEn: Life swings like a pendulum backward and forward between pain and boredom.

author: 奥古斯丁
quoteCn: 去爱吧，然后，随心所欲。
quoteEn: Love and do what you will

author: 阿瑟·爱丁顿
quoteCn: 亚原子世界并非由实体构成，而是由各种可能性交织而成。这何尝不是我们的人生？每一次选择，每一次呼吸，都蕴含着无限的可能，等待我们去发现，去创造。
quoteEn: The sub-atomic world is not a world of things, but a world of possibilities.

author: 阿尔图尔·兰波
quoteCn: 十七岁，我们何曾认真过？那是一种不被世俗规训的、纯粹的生命力。
quoteEn: We are not serious when we are seventeen.

author: 阿尔图尔·兰波
quoteCn: 我曾偶尔瞥见，那被世人称作星辰的光芒。
quoteEn: I have sometimes seen what man calls the stars.

author: 阿图尔·叔本华
quoteCn: 为了追逐任何形式的幸福，而以健康为代价，这无疑是人生最深重的愚蠢。
quoteEn: The greatest of follies is to sacrifice health for any other kind of happiness.

author: 本杰明·格雷厄姆
quoteCn: 投资者最大的对手，往往并非市场，而是他内心深处那个摇摆不定、充满恐惧与贪婪的自己。
quoteEn: The investor's chief problem - and even his worst enemy - is likely to be himself.

author: 比尔·布赖森
quoteCn: 与树为友，何尝不是一种深刻的慰藉？在无声的陪伴中，我们找回与自然的联结，也找回内心的平静。
quoteEn: There's nothing wrong with having a tree as a friend.

author: 比尔·布赖森
quoteCn: 我宁愿向一只飞鸟学唱一曲，也不愿去教万千星辰如何停止舞动。
quoteEn: I would rather learn from one bird how to sing than teach ten thousand stars how not to dance.

author: 博伊提乌斯
quoteCn: 所有外在的追逐，终不过是镜花水月。
quoteEn: Whatever is outside is all vain.

author: 博里斯·帕斯捷尔纳克
quoteCn: 创作的终极，是灵魂的慷慨馈赠。
quoteEn: The goal of creativity is self-giving

author: 博里斯·帕斯捷尔纳克
quoteCn: 爱人，是生命中最沉重的十字架，却也承载着最深沉的救赎。
quoteEn: To love others is a heavy cross

author: 博里斯·帕斯捷尔纳克
quoteCn: 声名显赫，并非总是光彩照人。
quoteEn: To be famous is not beautiful.

author: 卡尔·萨根
quoteCn: 我们DNA里的氮，牙齿里的钙，血液里的铁，甚至苹果派里的碳，都曾是坍缩恒星深处的烈焰。我们，是星辰的碎片。
quoteEn: The nitrogen in our DNA, the calcium in our teeth, the iron in our blood, the carbon in our apple pies were made in the interiors of collapsing stars. We are made of starstuff.

author: 卡尔·萨根
quoteCn: 若要从无到有烤制一个苹果派，你得先从创造宇宙开始。
quoteEn: If you wish to make an apple pie from scratch, you must first invent the universe.

author: 卡尔·萨根
quoteCn: 我们这般渺小的生灵，唯有爱，才能承载这浩瀚无垠的宇宙。
quoteEn: For small creatures such as we the vastness is bearable only through love.

author: 查尔斯·波德莱尔
quoteCn: 所谓天才，不过是我们在成年后，仍能随心所欲地重拾那份孩童般的好奇与纯粹。
quoteEn: Genius is nothing but childhood regained at will.

author: 查尔斯·波德莱尔
quoteCn: 创造的狂喜之后，便是毁灭的极致快感。
quoteEn: The greatest pleasure, after that of creating, is that of destroying.

author: 查尔斯·狄更斯
quoteCn: 年入二十镑，支出十九镑十九先令六便士，余下的是幸福。年入二十镑，支出二十镑零六便士，余下的是痛苦。
quoteEn: Annual income twenty pounds, annual expenditure nineteen nineteen six, result happiness. Annual income twenty pounds, annual expenditure twenty pounds ought and six, result misery.

author: 查尔斯·狄更斯
quoteCn: 我深信，每个人都有不可剥夺的自由，去往那些无人问津的角落，只因那是他心之所向。
quoteEn: I hold it to be the inalienable right of anybody to walk where he likes, provided he walks where nobody wants to walk.

author: 查尔斯·狄更斯
quoteCn: 人道，是我的天职。众生福祉，是我的天职；慈悲、怜悯、宽恕与善意，无一不是我的天职。我世俗的营生，不过是这浩瀚天职海洋中的一滴水珠，微不足道。
quoteEn: Mankind was my business. The common welfare was my business; charity, mercy, forbearance, and benevolence, were, all, my business. The dealings of my trade were but a drop of water in the comprehensive ocean of my business!

author: 查尔斯·狄更斯
quoteCn: 愿你心底的温柔永不僵硬，灵魂的热忱永不疲惫，指尖的触碰永不带来伤害。
quoteEn: Have a heart that never hardens, a temper that never tires, and a touch that never hurts.

author: 查尔斯·古迪尔
quoteCn: 人类最伟大的发现，莫过于洞悉自身无涯的未知。
quoteEn: The greatest discovery of all time is the discovery of a man's own ignorance.

author: 夏洛蒂·勃朗特
quoteCn: 我心，绝无半分怯懦。
quoteEn: No coward soul is mine

author: 夏洛蒂·勃朗特
quoteCn: 被我们所爱之人铭记于心，便不算真正离去。
quoteEn: To live in the hearts we leave behind is not to die.

author: 夏洛蒂·勃朗特
quoteCn: 世间最深沉的悲伤，是那无声无息，无法言说的痛。
quoteEn: There is no grief like the grief that does not speak.

author: 查克·菲尼
quoteCn: 我不惧怕死亡的到来，我只怕此生从未真正地、尽情地活过。
quoteEn: I'm not afraid of dying. I'm just afraid of not living.

author: 西塞罗
quoteCn: 若天道不允，我便逆转冥河。
quoteEn: If I cannot bend the heavens, I will move Acheron.

author: 丹·阿里里
quoteCn: 幸福的真谛，并非拥有你所渴望的一切，而是珍视你已拥有的一切。
quoteEn: The key to happiness is not getting what you want, but wanting what you have.

author: 戴赫·劳伦斯
quoteCn: 别去探究创作者的本意，只管沉浸于作品本身带来的触动与启示。
quoteEn: Never trust the artist. Trust the tale.

author: 戴赫·劳伦斯
quoteCn: 在一个颠倒错乱的世界里，清醒本身就是最危险的生存姿态。
quoteEn: The most dangerous thing is to be sane in an insane world.

author: 戴赫·劳伦斯
quoteCn: 当一个人与内在的自我达成和解，他才真正触及自由的边界。
quoteEn: Man is free when he is in harmony with himself.

author: 丹尼尔·戈尔曼
quoteCn: 当你全然安住于此刻，便能从情绪的洪流中抽身，选择而非被动回应，找回那份失落已久的自主与平静。
quoteEn: The more you are able to stay present, the more you are able to choose your response instead of being hijacked by your emotions.

author: 大卫·多伊奇
quoteCn: 宇宙的奇诡，并非超乎我们想象，而是超乎我们想象力的边界。
quoteEn: The universe is not queerer than we suppose, but queerer than we can suppose.

author: 但丁
quoteCn: 天堂遗落人间的，唯有三物：璀璨星辰，烂漫花朵，以及纯真孩童。
quoteEn: Three things remain with us from paradise: stars, flowers, and children.

author: 丹尼尔·平克
quoteCn: 玩耍的对立面并非劳作，而是那无尽的沉郁。
quoteEn: The opposite of play is not work, it's depression.

author: 德里克·西弗斯
quoteCn: 学会放手吧。生命中，并非所有美好都注定永恒，有些相遇，只为教会你告别。
quoteEn: Learn to let go. Not everything is meant to be in your life forever.

author: 博伊提乌斯
quoteCn: 从尘世到星辰的旅途，从来都不是坦途，它布满了荆棘与试炼，却也因此，每一步都闪耀着不屈的微光。
quoteEn: The road from the earth to the stars is not an easy one.

author: 博伊提乌斯
quoteCn: 命运如琉璃，流光溢彩时，亦是其骤然破碎之际。
quoteEn: Fortune is a glass: when it shines, it breaks.

author: 卡尔·弗里德里希·高斯
quoteCn: 从根本上说，真正能触动我们灵魂深处的，唯有两样：一是浩瀚星辰，二是芸芸众生。
quoteEn: There are fundamentally only two things that truly interest us: the first is the stars and the second is people.

author: E·E·卡明斯
quoteCn: 在那个多么美好的小镇，人人皆活在其中，钟声此起彼伏，轻柔飘落。
quoteEn: anyone lived in a pretty how town with up so floating many bells down

author: 德尼·狄德罗
quoteCn: 想象力，是盘踞在你我心宅深处，那位时而狂野、时而低语的疯妇。她能点燃希望，也能引你坠入无尽的迷思。
quoteEn: Imagination is the madwoman of the house.

author: 埃德加·凯西
quoteCn: 这具皮囊，是灵魂的圣殿。
quoteEn: The body is the temple of the soul.

author: 埃德加·凯西
quoteCn: 你并非血肉之躯，你是一个灵魂，正在此生此世，体验人间。
quoteEn: You are a soul having a human experience.

author: 爱德蒙德·胡塞尔
quoteCn: 世界远不止你所见。
quoteEn: The world is not what it seems.

author: 埃德加·爱伦·坡
quoteCn: 我久久凝视那幽深的黑暗，伫立其中，惊疑、恐惧、揣测，梦着凡人未曾敢梦的梦。
quoteEn: Deep into that darkness peering, long I stood there, wondering, fearing, doubting, dreaming dreams no mortal ever dared to dream before.

author: 艾米·诺特
quoteCn: 没有诗人的灵魂，便无法成为真正的数学家。
quoteEn: One can't be a mathematician without being a poet in soul.

author: 艾米莉·狄金森
quoteCn: 我无法为死亡停驻，而它，却温柔地为我驻足。马车里，只有我们，和永恒。
quoteEn: Because I could not stop for Death - He kindly stopped for me - The Carriage held but just Ourselves - And Immortality -

author: 艾米莉·狄金森
quoteCn: 道尽真相，却要婉转。因为，直白往往失之偏颇。那份过于耀眼的真理，对我们脆弱的欢愉而言，是难以承受的。真相的绝妙，在于它那不期而遇的惊喜。
quoteEn: Tell all the Truth but tell it slant - Success in Circuit lies - Too bright for our infirm Delight - The Truth's superb surprise -

author: 爱德华·塔夫特
quoteCn: 图像的真正力量，在于它能撕开日常的帷幕，让我们瞥见那些从未预设、却又如此真实的瞬间。
quoteEn: The greatest value of a picture is when it forces us to notice what we never expected to see.

author: 爱德蒙德·胡塞尔
quoteCn: 生命，是一场永无止境的自我探寻之旅。
quoteEn: Life is an ongoing process of self-discovery.

author: 埃德温·哈勃
quoteCn: 那些最微弱、最难以触及的光，往往来自宇宙最深远的角落。
quoteEn: The faintest nebulae are the farthest away.

author: E·E·卡明斯
quoteCn: 在一个昼夜不停、竭力将你塑造成他人的世界里，坚持做回那个独一无二的自己，这本身就是人类所能打响的最艰难、也永无止境的战役。
quoteEn: to be nobody-but-yourself in a world which is doing its best, night and day, to make you everybody else - means to fight the hardest battle which any human being can fight; and never stop fighting.

author: 艾米莉·狄金森
quoteCn: 灵魂择其所爱，而后，门扉轻阖。于其神圣的多数，她全然不顾，遗世独立，如若无物。
quoteEn: The Soul selects her own Society - Then shuts the Door - On her divine Majority - Oblivious - as the Whole -

author: 伊拉斯谟
quoteCn: 那些能自嘲的人啊，总能从生活里找到无尽的乐趣。
quoteEn: He who laughs at himself never runs out of things to laugh at.

author: 恩里科·费米
quoteCn: 宇宙的深邃，只留下了两种可能：我们是唯一的孤星，或我们只是亿万星辰中的一粟。无论哪一种，都足以让灵魂颤栗，心生敬畏。
quoteEn: There are two possibilities: either we are alone in the Universe or we are not. Both are equally terrifying.

author: 伊拉斯谟
quoteCn: 避免诱惑的最好方式，是全然地臣服于它。
quoteEn: The best way to avoid temptation is to yield to it.

author: 埃里克·韦因斯坦
quoteCn: 宇宙，从不曾许诺为你而清晰。
quoteEn: The universe is not obliged to make sense to you.

author: 欧内斯特·拉塞福
quoteCn: 毁灭世界的，从来不是原子弹的轰鸣，而是我们内心深处，那份对未知世界的好奇与惊叹，悄然无息地枯萎。
quoteEn: The world is not going to be destroyed by atomic bombs. It is going to be destroyed by the loss of curiosity and wonder.

author: 恩里科·费米
quoteCn: 你最不该欺骗的，是你自己。可偏偏，你最容易欺骗的，也是你自己。
quoteEn: The first principle is that you must not fool yourself, and you are the easiest person to fool.

author: 伊壁鸠鲁
quoteCn: 真正支撑我们的，不是朋友伸出的那双手，而是我们深知，他们总会在那里，那份笃定与安心。
quoteEn: It is not so much our friends' help that helps us, as the confident knowledge that they will help us.

author: 厄尔温·薛定谔
quoteCn: 宇宙的精妙，有时令人心生敬畏，甚至觉得它完美得有些不可思议，仿佛超越了我们所能理解的范畴。
quoteEn: One can't help but feel that the universe is a little too perfect.

author: 伊壁鸠鲁
quoteCn: 别让那些未曾拥有的渴望，模糊了你此刻所握的珍贵。回望来时路，你现在所拥有的，也曾是你夜空中最亮的星辰，是你心底最深的期盼。
quoteEn: Do not spoil what you have by desiring what you have not; remember that what you now have was once among the things you only hoped for.

author: 尤金·伊昂斯库
quoteCn: 笑声，是人类的印记，却也刻下了荒诞的痕迹。
quoteEn: Laughter is the hallmark of man, but it is also the hallmark of the absurd.

author: 欧里庇得斯
quoteCn: 谁又能真正知晓，这所谓的生，是否真的比那未知的死，更值得眷恋？
quoteEn: Who knows if living is much better than dying?

author: 欧内斯特·海明威
quoteCn: 人，生来不为臣服。他或可被摧毁，但绝不会被击败。
quoteEn: Man is not made for defeat. A man can be destroyed but not defeated.

author: 弗朗西斯·培根
quoteCn: 快乐并非事物本身，而是我们赋予其意义后，从中生发出的感受。
quoteEn: It is not the pleasure that is in the things themselves, but the pleasure that we have from the things that we make of them.

author: 艾米莉·狄金森
quoteCn: 我栖居于无限可能，那比散文更广阔的殿堂，窗棂更多，门扉更敞亮。
quoteEn: I dwell in Possibility - A fairer House than Prose - More numerous of Windows - Superior - for Doors -

author: 尤金·伊昂斯库
quoteCn: 荒诞，是我们在混沌中，突然瞥见的那一丝清明，是意识对无序的温柔凝视。
quoteEn: The absurd is the conscious lucidity of the irrational.

author: 艾米莉·勃朗特
quoteCn: 我即希斯克利夫！他永恒地、永恒地盘踞我心：并非以愉悦的姿态，正如我亦无法时时取悦自我，而是以我存在本身的面貌。
quoteEn: I am Heathcliff! He's always, always in my mind: not as a pleasure, any more than I am always a pleasure to myself, but as my own being.

author: 弗朗茨·卡夫卡
quoteCn: 一座牢笼，竟也渴望寻觅一只飞鸟。
quoteEn: A cage went looking for a bird.

author: 欧里庇得斯
quoteCn: 世间无一人，能冷酷至此，对眼前悲苦无动于衷。
quoteEn: No one is so cruel that he would not weep at these things.

author: 弗朗茨·卡夫卡
quoteCn: 多数人的一生，不过是未曾真正绽放的序章，便已悄然落幕。
quoteEn: Most people die because they were never born.

author: 恩培多克勒
quoteCn: 万物皆有其内在的挣扎，这挣扎催生它们蓬勃生长，却又在它们盛极之时，亲手将其毁灭。
quoteEn: For strife is in them, and it stirs them up to grow, and again it slays them when they have grown.

author: 尤金·奥尼尔
quoteCn: 雾，如猫步般轻柔而至，无声无息地俯瞰港湾与城池，随后又悄然隐去。
quoteEn: The fog comes on little cat feet. It sits looking over harbor and city on silent haunches and then moves on.

author: 欧内斯特·海明威
quoteCn: 你无法通过迁徙，来摆脱那个如影随形的自己。
quoteEn: You can't get away from yourself by moving from one place to another.

author: 加西亚·马尔克斯
quoteCn: 世间万物，唯有幸福，能抚平那些无药可医的伤痕。
quoteEn: There is no medicine that can cure what happiness does not heal.

author: 加西亚·马尔克斯
quoteCn: 心的记忆，总能滤去苦涩，放大甘甜，正是这份温柔的幻术，才让我们得以与过往和解，继续前行。
quoteEn: The memory of the heart eliminates bad memories and magnifies the good ones, and thanks to that artifice, we manage to bear the past.

author: 伽利略·伽利莱
quoteCn: 酒，是阳光以水的形态，被温柔地挽留。
quoteEn: Wine is sunlight, held together by water.

author: 加西亚·马尔克斯
quoteCn: 这世间，不过是天堂乏善可陈的拙劣仿本。
quoteEn: The world is nothing but a poor copy of paradise.

author: 欧内斯特·海明威
quoteCn: 终点固然可期，但最终，真正塑造我们的，是那段跋涉的旅程。
quoteEn: It is good to have an end to journey toward; but it is the journey that matters, in the end.

author: 杰弗里·乔叟
quoteCn: 爱，是百般愁绪缠身的病症。
quoteEn: Love is a sickness full of woes

author: 杰弗里·乔叟
quoteCn: 避开喧嚣，与真诚为伴。
quoteEn: Flee from the press, and dwell with truthfulness;

author: 乔治·奥威尔
quoteCn: 当社会渐行渐远，背离了真相的航道，它便会以更深的憎恶，回敬那些敢于直言不讳的灵魂。
quoteEn: The further a society drifts from the truth, the more it will hate those who speak it.

author: 吉尔·德勒兹
quoteCn: 思想并非空中楼阁，它扎根于我们血肉之躯的感知与体验。
quoteEn: There is no thought without body.

author: 乔瓦尼·薄伽丘
quoteCn: 爱，是那团不曾燃尽，却持续灼热的火焰。
quoteEn: Love is a fire that burns without ever consuming.

author: 格雷厄姆·格林
quoteCn: 当一个人与自己的良心独处时，那份恐惧，才真正蚀骨。
quoteEn: A man is never as afraid as when he is alone with his conscience.

author: 汉娜·阿伦特
quoteCn: 教育，是那份深沉的叩问：我们是否爱这世界至深，足以肩负起它的未来。
quoteEn: Education is the point at which we decide whether we love the world enough to assume responsibility for it.

author: 汉娜·阿伦特
quoteCn: 思想，唯有挣脱藩篱，方能真正启蒙。
quoteEn: Thinking without a railing is the only way to learn to think.

author: 格雷厄姆·格林
quoteCn: 写作，是灵魂深处的一剂良药。我常想，那些不曾提笔、不曾谱曲、不曾描绘的人啊，究竟是如何在这人世间，逃脱那与生俱来的疯狂、深沉的忧郁，以及无处不在的恐慌呢？
quoteEn: Writing is a form of therapy; sometimes I wonder how all those who do not write, compose, or paint can manage to escape the madness, the melancholia, the panic fear which is inherent in the human situation.

author: 汉斯-乔治·伽达默尔
quoteCn: 传统并非是尘封于过往的遗迹，而是无形中托举我们、引领我们走向未来的力量。
quoteEn: Tradition is not something that lies behind us, but something that carries us

author: 亨rik·易卜生
quoteCn: 并非真理赋予我们自由，而是那份全然的自由，才让我们活出了真实的自我。
quoteEn: It is not the truth that sets man free, but freedom that makes man true.

author: 亨rik·易卜生
quoteCn: 世上最坚韧的灵魂，往往是那个独自面对一切的人。
quoteEn: The strongest man in the world is the one who stands most alone.

author: 亨利·凯泽
quoteCn: 我们攀登的，从来不是那座山峰，而是我们内心深处的自我。
quoteEn: It is not the mountain we conquer but ourselves.

author: 亨rik·易卜生
quoteCn: 世间至强的灵魂，往往是那踽踽独行，却又最能与自我深处对话的人。
quoteEn: The strongest of all in the world is the one who stands most alone.

author: 亨利·詹姆斯
quoteCn: 去尽情体验你所能拥有的一切吧，不去感受，才是生命最大的错失。你具体做了什么，其实没那么重要，重要的是你真正拥有了你的生命。如果连这最宝贵的生命体验都缺席了，你又真正拥有过什么呢？
quoteEn: Live all you can; it's a mistake not to. It doesn't so much matter what you do in particular, so long as you have your life. If you haven't had that what have you had?

author: 亨利·詹姆斯
quoteCn: 未来如谜，往昔之路，再无归途。
quoteEn: The future is a mystery to us, and the past is a path that cannot be retraced.

author: 赫拉克利特
quoteCn: 人点燃了自己内心的光，却也常常亲手将其熄灭，在得失之间，尽显生命无常。
quoteEn: Man touches his own light and extinguishes it himself.

author: 奥诺雷·德·巴尔扎克
quoteCn: 爱，是那个从不计较得失的孩子。
quoteEn: Love is a child that does not know how to count.

author: 希拉里·普特南
quoteCn: 我们生来便置身于意义的洪流，而我们，亦有能力去雕琢、去创造属于自己的全新意义。
quoteEn: We are all born into a world of meaning, and we are all capable of creating new meanings.

author: 赫尔姆霍兹
quoteCn: 世界并非以其本来的面目呈现，而是被我们内在的思绪所塑造。
quoteEn: The world is not as we see it, but as we think it.

author: 奥诺雷·德·巴尔扎克
quoteCn: 幸福，宛如一位绝代佳人，你若凝视过久，她便会悄然隐去。
quoteEn: Happiness is like a beautiful woman if you look at her too long, she disappears.

author: 奥诺雷·德·巴尔扎克
quoteCn: 静默是神谕的低语，其余喧嚣，皆是凡人的转译。
quoteEn: The silence is the language of God, all the rest is just translation.

author: 伊曼努尔·康德
quoteCn: 人非为幸福而生，却能为自己创造幸福。
quoteEn: Man is not meant to be happy, but to make himself happy.

author: 伊利亚·普里戈金
quoteCn: 时间并非单向奔流的河，而是我们沉浮其中、无边无际的海。
quoteEn: Time is not a river that flows in one direction, but a sea in which we swim.

author: 以赛亚·柏林
quoteCn: 真正的自由，并非无拘无束，而是洞悉万物皆有其束缚，并以清醒的意志，选择你甘愿背负的重量。
quoteEn: The only way to be truly free is to be able to choose your own chains.

author: 以赛亚·柏林
quoteCn: 对极致理想的追逐，往往以摧毁当下美好作结。
quoteEn: The pursuit of the ideal ends by destroying the good.

author: 伊万·屠格涅夫
quoteCn: 人，生来就是为了幸福，一如飞鸟生来就为翱翔天际。
quoteEn: Man is created for happiness, just as a bird is created for flight.

author: 伊万·屠格涅夫
quoteCn: 爱，是唯一能让我们卸下所有防备，不觉卑微的存在。
quoteEn: Love is the only form of existence in which a person does not feel humiliated.

author: J.M. 库切
quoteCn: 唯有当你放下被阅读的执念，笔尖才能触及那不加修饰的真实。
quoteEn: The only way to write the truth is to assume that what you set down will never be read.

author: 杰克·伦敦
quoteCn: 狗的爱，纯粹而无暇。它不求爱抚，不求赞美，不求温饱——只愿你看见它的存在，便已足够。
quoteEn: The love of a dog is a pure thing. He asks for nothing in return, no caress, no praise, no food—just that you acknowledge him.

author: 雅克·拉康
quoteCn: 爱，是献出你所不曾拥有的。
quoteEn: Love is a gift of what one does not have.

author: 雅克·拉康
quoteCn: 真相，总是以一种残缺不全的方式，被我们半遮半掩地吐露。
quoteEn: The truth is always told halfway.

author: 詹姆斯·克利尔
quoteCn: 塑造我们的，从来不是生命本身的起伏，而是我们如何解读那些起伏，赋予它们意义。
quoteEn: It is not the events of our lives that shape us, but our interpretation of them.

author: 詹姆斯·瓦特
quoteCn: 我的世界，只剩下这台机器的呼吸与脉动。
quoteEn: I can think of nothing else but this machine.

author: 让·拉辛
quoteCn: 唯有那些困囿于狭隘心境的灵魂，才会被仇恨所吞噬。
quoteEn: Only small souls know hatred.

author: 让-保罗·萨特
quoteCn: 生而为人，性别并非宿命，而是自我选择与社会塑造的交织。
quoteEn: One is not born a woman, one becomes one.

author: 让·鲍德里亚尔
quoteCn: 我们身处一个信息泛滥的时代，意义却如潮水般退去，留下空茫的沙滩。
quoteEn: We live in a world where there is more and more information, and less and less meaning.

author: 让-保罗·萨特
quoteCn: 承诺，是灵魂深处的一次自我抉择，是意志对自我的锻造，更是生命向更高维度的超越。
quoteEn: Commitment is an act by which man chooses himself, forges himself, transcends himself.

author: 约翰尼斯·开普勒
quoteCn: 我曾丈量星空，追逐群星的轨迹，宇宙的重量，也曾在我掌中。
quoteEn: I have measured the heavens, I have tracked the movements of the stars, I have weighed the universe in my hands.

author: 约翰·塞巴斯蒂安·巴赫
quoteCn: 音乐，是神明赠予的慰藉，它轻柔地托起我们，超越尘世的一切喧嚣与烦忧。
quoteEn: Music is a gift from God that can free us from all earthly worries.

author: 让-雅克·卢梭
quoteCn: 自由，并非随心所欲的放纵，而是灵魂深处，拒绝被他人意志所奴役的坚定。
quoteEn: Freedom consists less in doing what one wants than in not being subjected to the will of others.

author: 约翰·杜威
quoteCn: 一个社会之所以伟大，是因为那些老人，明知此生无缘，依然亲手种下树苗，只为后世能有片刻荫凉。
quoteEn: A society grows great when old men plant trees whose shade they know they shall never sit in.

author: 约翰·旦恩
quoteCn: 爱，若因世事流转而变色，或随人心易改而动摇，那便不是真爱。不，爱是那永恒矗立的灯塔，任凭风暴肆虐，它自岿然不动。
quoteEn: Love is not love which alters when it alteration finds, / Or bends with the remover to remove: / O no! it is an ever-fixed mark / That looks on tempests and is never shaken.

author: 约翰·沃尔夫冈·冯·歌德
quoteCn: 世间万物，转瞬即逝，不过是生命深处的一场隐喻。
quoteEn: All transient things are but a metaphor.

author: 约翰·济慈
quoteCn: 是幻象，还是清醒的梦境？那乐音已逝，我究竟是醒着，还是沉睡？
quoteEn: Was it a vision, or a waking dream? Fled is that music: - Do I wake or sleep?

author: 约翰·梅纳德·凯恩斯
quoteCn: 长远来看，我们终将归于尘土。何不活在当下，尽情绽放？
quoteEn: In the long run we are all dead.

author: 约翰·弥尔顿
quoteCn: 与其在天堂里卑微顺从，不如在地狱中称王称霸。
quoteEn: Better to reign in hell, than serve in heaven.

author: 约翰·旦恩
quoteCn: 去吧，去追逐那坠落的星辰，/ 让曼德拉草孕育生命，/ 告诉我，那些逝去的岁月究竟去了何方？/ 又或者，是谁劈开了魔鬼的足迹。
quoteEn: Go, and catch a falling star, / Get with child a mandrake root, / Tell me where all past years are, / Or who cleft the Devil's foot.

author: 约翰·凯恩斯·加尔布雷思
quoteCn: 那些约定俗成的观念，往往只是我们逃避深刻思考的温柔乡。
quoteEn: The conventional view serves to protect us from the painful job of thinking.

author: 约翰·斯坦贝克
quoteCn: 人与鼠的精心筹谋，也常会落空。生命无常，徒留一声叹息。
quoteEn: The best laid schemes o' mice an' men gang aft agley.

author: 约翰·弥尔顿
quoteCn: 当他们高呼自由时，内心深处，或许只是渴望无拘无束的放纵。
quoteEn: Licence they mean when they cry liberty.

author: 约翰·梅纳德·凯恩斯
quoteCn: 真正的困境，并非在于接纳那些崭新的念头，而在于如何挣脱旧有观念的束缚。它们像藤蔓般，深深扎根于我们心智的每个角落，塑造了我们，也禁锢了我们。
quoteEn: The difficulty lies, not in the new ideas, but in escaping from the old ones, which ramify, for those brought up as most of us have been, into every corner of our minds.

author: 约翰·厄普代克
quoteCn: 唯有写作，能让我真切感受到，自己正活在当下，有所作为。
quoteEn: Writing is the only thing that, when I do it, makes me feel I am doing something.

author: 约翰·厄普代克
quoteCn: 心之所向，皆为感官的盛宴。
quoteEn: The life of the mind is a life of the senses.

author: 约翰·厄普代克
quoteCn: 艺术家，是那个在混沌中开辟一方天地，只为我们能完整地、不带偏见地，看清这世界本真模样的人。
quoteEn: The artist is a person who is trying to create a space in which to see the world whole.

author: 约瑟夫·康拉德
quoteCn: 我们活在世上，一如在梦中——独自一人。
quoteEn: We live as we dream - alone.

author: 约瑟夫·坎贝尔
quoteCn: 若你所见的道路，每一步都清晰可辨，那便不是你真正的路。
quoteEn: If you can see your path laid out in front of you step by step, you know it's not your path.

author: 约翰·旦恩
quoteCn: 死亡啊，你无需张扬，即便世人曾将你奉为强大与可怖，可你，并非如此。
quoteEn: Death be not proud, though some have called thee Mighty and dreadful, for thou art not so.

author: 约翰·旦恩
quoteCn: 丧钟为谁而鸣？它为你而鸣。这钟声，是为每一个生命敲响的，也是为此刻的你我而鸣。
quoteEn: For whom the bell tolls, it tolls for thee.

author: 约翰·厄普代克
quoteCn: 生命的意义，终究在于全然地活过，在于极致地品尝每一次经历，在于热切而无畏地，伸出手去拥抱那些崭新而丰盛的体验。
quoteEn: The purpose of life, after all, is to live it, to taste experience to the utmost, to reach out eagerly and without fear for newer and richer experience.

author: 卡尔·雅斯贝尔斯
quoteCn: 每一次真诚的对话，都是我们存在意义的深刻印证。
quoteEn: Communication is the realization of existence.

author: 卡尔·雅斯贝尔斯
quoteCn: 自由，是允许自己跌倒的勇气，是拥抱不确定性的可能。
quoteEn: Freedom is the possibility of failure.

author: 卡尔·雅斯贝尔斯
quoteCn: 存在，是那不可被定义、不可被量度、不可被外化的生命本真。
quoteEn: Existence is that which cannot be objectified.

author: 卡尔·雅斯贝尔斯
quoteCn: 罪感，是自由的另一面。它像一枚硬币的两面，不可分割，却又各自沉重。
quoteEn: Guilt is the flip side of freedom.

author: 约翰·纳什
quoteCn: 若不甘长久地告别海岸线，便无从触及新大陆。这是一种对未知的勇敢，也是对旧有的释怀。
quoteEn: One does not discover new lands without consenting to lose sight of the shore for a very long time.

author: 约翰·纳什
quoteCn: 心，如一片浩瀚的海洋。它深不可测，暗流涌动；它经历狂风骤雨，也享受风平浪静；它孕育生命，也见证消逝。
quoteEn: The mind is an ocean. It has great depths and great currents. It has storms and calms. It has life and death.

author: 库尔特·哥德尔
quoteCn: 世界，远比我们想象的，要复杂得多。
quoteEn: The world is not as simple as we would like it to be.

author: 列夫·托尔斯泰
quoteCn: 幸福并非是随心所欲，而是发自内心地爱上你所做的一切。
quoteEn: Happiness is not about doing what you want, but wanting what you do.

author: 列夫·托尔斯泰
quoteCn: 人如分数，分子是他真实的模样，分母是他对自己的衡量。分母越大，他生命的价值便越微小。
quoteEn: A man is a fraction, the numerator of which is what he is, and the denominator is what he thinks of himself. The larger the denominator, the smaller the fraction.

author: 列夫·托尔斯泰
quoteCn: 复仇，那瞬间的快意，实则饮鸩止渴，蚀骨噬魂。
quoteEn: Revenge is a pleasure that poisons the soul.

author: 乔西亚·威拉德·吉布斯
quoteCn: 追求极致，有时反会错失当下的美好。
quoteEn: The best is the enemy of the good.

author: 库尔特·哥德尔
quoteCn: 唯有勇敢地跨越已知，触碰那看似不可能的边界，我们才能真正洞悉何为可能。
quoteEn: The only way to discover the limits of the possible is by going beyond them into the impossible.

author: 马塞尔·普鲁斯特
quoteCn: 爱，是灵魂深处的一束恩典之光。
quoteEn: Love is a state of grace.

author: 马塞尔·普鲁斯特
quoteCn: 虚掷的光阴，并非指无所事事，而是那些我们不曾热爱、不曾投入的时光。
quoteEn: Lost time is not the time spent doing nothing; it is the time spent doing something we did not enjoy.

author: 马塞尔·普鲁斯特
quoteCn: 生命如梦，却是一场能被温柔忆起的梦。
quoteEn: Life is a dream, but a dream that one can remember.

author: 马尔库斯·奥勒留
quoteCn: 接受命运的馈赠，无论是际遇还是人。以你全部的心，去爱，去拥抱，去释然。
quoteEn: Accept the things to which fate binds you, and love the people with whom fate brings you together, but do so with all your heart.

author: 马里奥·巴尔加斯·略萨
quoteCn: 作家，是那个不甘于世界本来的样子，而选择用文字重塑它的人。
quoteEn: The writer is a man who refuses to accept the world as it is.

author: 马里奥·巴尔加斯·略萨
quoteCn: 记忆，有时是无声的复仇，它让过去在心底反复上演，或以遗憾，或以不甘，或以某种深刻的警醒，悄然重塑着我们。
quoteEn: Memory is a form of revenge.

author: 马里奥·巴尔加斯·略萨
quoteCn: 生命是一场未知的跋涉，而非终点可及的彼岸。
quoteEn: Life is an adventure, not a destination.

author: 马丁·布伯
quoteCn: 人，并非孤立存在，而是因所爱而生，因所爱而活。
quoteEn: The human being does not live by himself, but by what he loves.

author: 马克·吐温
quoteCn: 并非未知将你困囿，而是你笃信的虚妄，将你牢牢束缚。
quoteEn: It ain't what you don't know that gets you into trouble. It's what you know for sure that just ain't so.

author: 约瑟夫·坎贝尔
quoteCn: 此生最珍贵的馈赠，便是成为你本来的样子。
quoteEn: The privilege of a lifetime is being who you are.

author: 马丁·布伯
quoteCn: 世间万语，唯有“爱”字，被误解和滥用得最深。
quoteEn: There is no word that has been so abused as the word love.

author: 马丁·布伯
quoteCn: 人，唯有在回应中，才真正活出了人的样子。
quoteEn: The human being is only fully human where he answers.

author: 马丁·布伯
quoteCn: 人，唯有在与你的相遇中，才得以成为完整的我。
quoteEn: The human being becomes an I through the Thou.

author: 马克斯·谢勒
quoteCn: 爱，是唯一能让你真正触及另一个灵魂深处，从其内在光芒中洞悉一切的路径。
quoteEn: Love is the only way to see another being from the inside out.

author: 马克斯·谢勒
quoteCn: 爱的秘密，远比死亡的秘密更为深邃。
quoteEn: The secret of love is greater than the secret of death.

author: 马丁·海德格尔
quoteCn: 人并非万物的主宰，而是存在的牧者。我们只是看护者，而非拥有者。
quoteEn: The man is not the master of beings. The man is the shepherd of being.

author: 路德维希·费尔巴哈
quoteCn: 你所构想的，即是你本身。
quoteEn: Man is what he imagines.

author: 马克斯·谢勒
quoteCn: 最大的罪，不是犯错，而是放弃所有希望，陷入绝望的深渊。
quoteEn: The greatest sin is despair.

author: 马克斯·谢勒
quoteCn: 人，生来便是一场自我超越的旅程。
quoteEn: Man is a being that transcends itself.

author: 莫里斯·梅洛-庞蒂
quoteCn: 感知并非世界的复刻，而是我们与世界共舞的创造。
quoteEn: Perception is not a copy of the world, but a construction of the world.

author: 迈克尔·法拉第
quoteCn: 并非总要马不停蹄。在静默的等待中，蕴藏着足以撼动山河的巨大力量。
quoteEn: Work is not always required. There is a mighty power in waiting.

author: 迈克尔·刘易斯
quoteCn: 资本主义的困境在于，它最终会如你所愿，将你所求的一切奉上。
quoteEn: The problem with capitalism is that it eventually gives you what you want.

author: 迈克尔·法拉第
quoteCn: 有两样事物，越是沉思，越是持久凝视，它们就越能以崭新的、不断增长的敬畏与惊叹充盈我的心灵：那高悬于我之上的璀璨星空，以及深植于我之内的道德法则。
quoteEn: Two things fill the mind with ever new and increasing admiration and awe, the oftener and more steadily we reflect upon them: the starry heavens above me and the moral law within me.

author: 迈克尔·法拉第
quoteCn: 世间万物皆有其美。只是我们常常忘了驻足，忘了环顾四周，去发现那些被忽略的温柔与光亮。
quoteEn: The world is full of beauty. But we have to stop and look around to discover it.

author: 蒙田
quoteCn: 最美的生命，是那不被世俗喧嚣所扰，静默绽放的。
quoteEn: The most beautiful life is the one that is least noticed.

author: 加来道雄
quoteCn: 人生最壮丽的远征，莫过于向我们内心深处那片未知疆域的探索。
quoteEn: The greatest adventure of all is the exploration of the human mind.

author: 蒙田
quoteCn: 世间至伟，亦不过一介凡人。
quoteEn: The greatest man in the world is but a man.

author: 马克斯·韦伯
quoteCn: 有些事，若不为之，你将无法原谅自己。
quoteEn: There are things you cannot do without despising yourself.

author: 米格尔·德·塞万提斯
quoteCn: 时间是世间最伟大的编剧，它总能为所有故事，写下最恰如其分的结局。
quoteEn: Time is the best author: it always finds a perfect ending.

author: 蒙田
quoteCn: 我们皆是凡尘学徒，而痛苦，才是那无声的、最严苛的导师。
quoteEn: Man is an apprentice, pain is his master.

author: 米兰·昆德拉
quoteCn: 媚俗，是对生命中那些不完美、不体面、甚至令人作呕部分的彻底否认。
quoteEn: Kitsch is the absolute denial of shit.

author: 米兰·昆德拉
quoteCn: 爱，让我们在苦痛面前如此无力；而当爱逝去或不再被回应，我们便坠入最深切的孤独与不幸。
quoteEn: We are never so defenseless against suffering as when we love, never so forlornly unhappy as when we have lost our love object or when it no longer loves us.

author: 莫里哀
quoteCn: 生命，于深思者是喜剧，于多情者是悲剧。
quoteEn: Life is a comedy to those who think, a tragedy to those who feel.

author: 莫里哀
quoteCn: 人最大的不幸，莫过于他自认为不幸。
quoteEn: Man is never so unhappy as when he thinks he is.

author: 特蕾莎修女
quoteCn: 重要的从来不是你做了多大的事，而是你倾注了多少爱意。这份爱，才是衡量一切的真正尺度。
quoteEn: It is not the magnitude of the deed but the amount of love put into it that matters.

author: 加来道雄
quoteCn: 宇宙不只是一堆粒子，它更是思想的交响乐章。
quoteEn: The universe is not just a collection of particles, it is a symphony of ideas.

author: 特蕾莎修女
quoteCn: 我们无法完成什么惊天动地的大事，但我们能以满溢的爱，去做好每一件微不足道的小事。
quoteEn: We can do no great things; only small things with great love.

author: 尼科洛·马基雅维利
quoteCn: 永远不要对一个人施加如此深重的伤害，以至于剥夺了他仅有的希望。
quoteEn: One should never do a man such a great wrong as to take away his hope.

author: 尼古拉斯·塔勒布
quoteCn: 脆弱的反面并非坚韧，而是反脆弱。那些反脆弱的，能从混沌无序中汲取力量，逆势生长。
quoteEn: The opposite of fragile is not robust, but antifragile. What is antifragile benefits from disorder.

author: 尼科洛·马基雅维利
quoteCn: 世人多凭眼见以论断，而非亲身感知；因为目之所及人人皆能，心之所感却寥若晨星。
quoteEn: Men generally judge more by their eyes than by their hands; for it is up to everyone to see, while few can feel.

author: 尼尔斯·玻尔
quoteCn: 我们所执着的一切真实，其根基却是由那些无法被定义为真实的存在所编织。
quoteEn: Everything we call real is made of things that cannot be regarded as real.

author: 尼古莱·果戈里
quoteCn: 先生们，这世间，何其无趣啊！
quoteEn: It's boring in this world, gentlemen!

author: 奥利弗·萨克斯
quoteCn: 我们终其一生，都在编织一个关于自己的故事，那便是我们所认知的“自我”。
quoteEn: The self is a narrative, a story we tell ourselves about ourselves.

author: 奥利弗·萨克斯
quoteCn: 重要的不是病痛本身，而是承受它的人。因为在病痛面前，我们才更清晰地看见一个生命的完整与尊严。
quoteEn: It is not the disease that matters, but the person who has it.

author: 奥利弗·萨克斯
quoteCn: 沟通的真谛，在于聆听那些未曾言说的沉默，感受话语背后涌动的情绪与渴望。
quoteEn: The most important thing in communication is to hear what isn't being said.

author: 巴勃罗·毕加索
quoteCn: 我从不刻意寻觅，我只是偶然遇见。
quoteEn: I don't seek, I find.

author: 奥维德
quoteCn: 命运如琉璃，光华流转处，亦是碎裂时。
quoteEn: Fortune is glass: when it shines, it breaks.

author: 巴门尼德
quoteCn: 过去不曾，未来亦无，唯有此刻，是永恒的合一与绵延。
quoteEn: There was never, nor will there ever be, since now is all, one, continuous.

author: 奥维德
quoteCn: 若命运不允，我便逆流而上，即使那是冥河的深渊。
quoteEn: If I cannot bend the heavens, I will move the Acheron.

author: 菲利普·罗斯
quoteCn: 生命短暂，何不尽情活出自我，不留遗憾。
quoteEn: We are not going to live forever, so we might as well do what we want to do.

author: 菲利普·罗斯
quoteCn: 写作，是智者对世事无常最深刻的、无声的反击。
quoteEn: Writing is the revenge of the intelligent.

author: 普罗提诺
quoteCn: 通往至善的道路，并非逻辑推演，而是心底深处那份不言而喻的直觉指引。
quoteEn: The way to the Good is not by reasoning, but by a kind of intuition.

author: 皮埃尔-西蒙·拉普拉斯
quoteCn: 我们所知，不过沧海一粟；而未知，却是浩瀚无垠的宇宙。
quoteEn: What we know is a little thing; what we do not know is immense.

author: 瑞纳·玛利亚·里尔克
quoteCn: 万物皆有其微光，只是我们需有心去看见。
quoteEn: Every thing has its own glory, but one must be able to see it.

author: 瑞纳·玛利亚·里尔克
quoteCn: 所有真正的丰盛，都悄然无声地生长；所有生命的孕育，都在无言的深处发生。
quoteEn: For all fertility is silent and quiet, and becoming in the womb is voiceless.

author: 瑞纳·玛利亚·里尔克
quoteCn: 活着，就是一场永无止境的蜕变。
quoteEn: For living means to be transformed.

author: 理查德·瓦格纳
quoteCn: 音乐，是那些无法言说、却又无法沉默的情感，最深沉的表达。
quoteEn: Music expresses that which cannot be said and on which it is impossible to be silent.

author: 理查德·费曼
quoteCn: 自然的奇思妙想，远超人类的任何构想。
quoteEn: The imagination of nature is far, far greater than the imagination of man.

author: 罗伯特·弗罗斯特
quoteCn: 人间，是爱最恰当的归宿。我实在想不出，爱还能去往何处，会比这里更好。
quoteEn: Earth's the right place for love: I don't know where it's likely to go better.

author: 理查德·费曼
quoteCn: 我宁可怀揣那些无解的疑问，也不愿拥抱那些不容置喙的答案。
quoteEn: I would rather have questions that can't be answered than answers that can't be questioned.

author: 罗伯特·弗罗斯特
quoteCn: 多年以后，我将轻叹一声，讲述这段往事。
quoteEn: I shall be telling this with a sigh

author: 罗曼·罗兰
quoteCn: 艺术，是人类对抗生命无常与苦痛，所能创造出的最温柔、最动人的慰藉。
quoteEn: Art is the most beautiful of the consolations that man has invented against the miseries of life.

author: 罗曼·罗兰
quoteCn: 世间万物，唯有一事比滔滔不绝地谈论自我更糟，那便是，对自我缄口不言。
quoteEn: There is only one thing in the world worse than talking about oneself: not talking about oneself.

author: 罗伯特·潘·华伦
quoteCn: 诗歌，是那至高无上的虚构，却比现实更真实地触及灵魂。
quoteEn: Poetry is the supreme fiction.

author: 罗曼·罗兰
quoteCn: 生活，并非你我所愿的模样，它只是它本来的样子。而我们，有幸能让这本来的样子，多一分温柔与光亮。
quoteEn: Life is not what it should be. It is what it is. It is up to us to make it better.

author: 罗曼·罗兰
quoteCn: 爱，是唯一能让我们真切感受到，在这浩瀚宇宙中，我们并非孤身一人。
quoteEn: Love is the only thing that can make us feel that we are not alone.

author: 罗伯特·潘·华伦
quoteCn: 艺术，是那面映照人心的镜子，让灵魂的褶皱与光华无所遁形。
quoteEn: The purpose of art is to lay bare the human soul.

author: 山姆·哈里斯
quoteCn: 冥想并非要你强行停止思绪，而是让你看穿它们，如同看穿一场幻象。
quoteEn: Meditation is not about stopping thoughts, but about seeing through them.

author: 萨尔瓦多·达利
quoteCn: 每个清晨，当我从梦中醒来，都会被一种至高无上的喜悦所浸润——那便是，我依然是我，萨尔瓦多·达利。
quoteEn: Every morning, upon waking, I experience a supreme pleasure that of being Salvador Dalí.

author: 萨尔瓦多·达利
quoteCn: 不必为追求完美而焦虑，因为那本就是一场永无止境的旅程。
quoteEn: Don’t be afraid of perfection, you’ll never reach it.

author: 山姆·哈里斯
quoteCn: 心智并非被动承受的命运，而是我们亲手塑造的奇迹。
quoteEn: The mind is not something that happens to us. It is something we create.

author: 西格蒙德·弗洛伊德
quoteCn: 人，终究要学会接纳众生的本相。
quoteEn: Man must take people as they are.

author: 塞缪尔·贝克特
quoteCn: 世间万物，莫过于不幸更显荒诞，尤其是旁人的不幸。
quoteEn: Nothing is funnier than unhappiness, especially other people's.

author: 西蒙·西尼克
quoteCn: 不必苛求终局的完美，只愿今日胜过昨日的自己。
quoteEn: The goal is not to be perfect by the end. The goal is to be better today.

author: 辛克莱·刘易斯
quoteCn: 生活并非一场华丽的演出，也非一席饕餮的盛宴；它更像是一道无解的谜题，一种无处可逃的境遇。
quoteEn: Life is not a spectacle or a feast; it is a predicament.

author: 罗伯特·潘·华伦
quoteCn: 书写真实，唯有深信你所感受的，即是你所知的。
quoteEn: The only way to write the truth is to assume that what one feels is what one knows.

author: 斯拉沃热·齐泽克
quoteCn: 希望并非是对结果的盲目乐观，而是深知万事万物自有其存在的意义，无论结局如何，这份意义都将永存。
quoteEn: Hope is not the conviction that something will turn out well, but the certainty that something makes sense, regardless of how it turns out.

author: 苏格拉底
quoteCn: 未经内省的人生，如同虚度，不值得被称颂。
quoteEn: An unexamined life is not worth living.

author: 斯拉沃热·齐泽克
quoteCn: 我们宁愿构想世界的末日，也不愿直面资本主义的终结。
quoteEn: It is easier to imagine the end of the world than the end of capitalism.

author: 索福克勒斯
quoteCn: 挚友间的共鸣与和声，远胜过世间一切浮华与财富。
quoteEn: The harmony of good friends is more valuable than all wealth.

author: 西格蒙德·弗洛伊德
quoteCn: 你以为你是你，但你只是潜意识的傀儡，被无形的力量牵引着，在自己的屋子里迷失。
quoteEn: The self is not master in its own house.

author: 史蒂夫·乔布斯
quoteCn: 记住你终将逝去，是我所知避免患得患失的最好方式。你本就赤裸而来，还有什么理由不追随你心？
quoteEn: Remembering that you are going to die is the best way I know to avoid the trap of thinking you have something to lose. You are already naked. There is no reason not to follow your heart.

author: 塞缪尔·贝克特
quoteCn: 我已无力前行，但我仍将前行。
quoteEn: I can't go on, I'll go on.

author: 史蒂芬·柯维
quoteCn: 我们常常不是为了理解而倾听，而是为了回应而等待。这份急切，有时让我们错失了心与心交汇的可能。
quoteEn: Most people do not listen with the intent to understand; they listen with the intent to reply.

author: 西尔维亚·普拉斯
quoteCn: 你此生所能遭遇最强大的对手，始终是你内在的那个自己。
quoteEn: The worst enemy you can meet will always be yourself.

author: 苏珊·凯恩
quoteCn: 独处，不是孤单，而是与完整的自我深情相拥。
quoteEn: The ability to be alone is the ability to be with yourself.

author: 西尔维亚·普拉斯
quoteCn: 若心无所期，便无所失落。这并非冷漠，而是与无常共舞的智慧。
quoteEn: If you expect nothing from anybody, you are never disappointed.

author: 索伦·基尔克郭尔
quoteCn: 生命，我们只能向前奔赴，却唯有回望，方能洞悉其深意。
quoteEn: Life is lived forward, but it is understood backward.

author: 泰德·特纳
quoteCn: 我从不畏惧跌倒，真正让我心生恐惧的，是那从未启程的空白。
quoteEn: I'm not afraid to fail. In fact, I'm afraid not to try.

author: 索伦·基尔克郭尔
quoteCn: 人，是无限与有限的交织，永恒与须臾的共生，自由与必然的宿命。
quoteEn: The human being is a synthesis of the infinite and the finite, of the eternal and the temporal, of freedom and necessity.

author: 泰勒斯
quoteCn: 时间，是所有智者中最深邃的那个，因为它最终会轻柔地掀开所有面纱，让一切真相显露无遗。
quoteEn: Time is the wisest of all; for it reveals everything

author: T.S.艾略特
quoteCn: 我们终将停止探索，/ 而我们所有探索的终点，/ 便是抵达最初的起点，/ 第一次，真正地认识它。
quoteEn: We shall not cease from exploration / And the end of all our exploring / Will be to arrive where we started / And know the place for the first time.

author: 托马斯·阿奎那
quoteCn: 恐惧，不过是灵魂对未来阴影的预设。
quoteEn: Fear is nothing but the expectation of future evil.

author: T.S.艾略特
quoteCn: 四月，最是无情，它让死寂的土地开出丁香，将记忆与欲望混杂，又用春雨唤醒沉睡的根。这并非生机，而是无尽的挣扎与回响。
quoteEn: April is the cruellest month, breeding / Lilacs out of the dead land, mixing / Memory and desire, stirring / Dull roots with spring rain.

author: 托马斯·弗里德曼
quoteCn: 世界并非坦途，它沟壑纵横，起伏跌宕，却也因此，惊喜不断。
quoteEn: The world is not flat. It's lumpy, bumpy, and full of surprises.

author: 托马斯·霍布斯
quoteCn: 当所有希望都已沉寂，恐惧便成了唯一的激情。
quoteEn: Fear is the passion of him that hath no other hope.

author: 索伦·基尔克郭尔
quoteCn: 成为自己，这本身就是一场旷日持久的修行，一种需要毕生去精进的艺术。
quoteEn: It is indeed a great art to be oneself.

author: 托马斯·曼
quoteCn: 死亡，是我们唯一确凿无疑、终将赴约的远行。
quoteEn: The death is the only adventure that we can be sure to experience.

author: 托马斯·库恩
quoteCn: 所谓发现，不过是漫长而痛楚的蜕变，最终学会以全新的眼光，温柔地审视这个世界。
quoteEn: What we call discovery is often the result of a long and painful process of learning to see the world in a new way.

author: 西尔维亚·普拉斯
quoteCn: 我从不为这世界哭泣，我只为那个我永远无法抵达的自己而哭泣。
quoteEn: I do not weep at the world - I weep for what I cannot be.

author: 托马斯·沃尔夫
quoteCn: 每个人都是自己的国王，也都是自己命运的囚徒。
quoteEn: Every man is a king, and every man is a prisoner.

author: 维克多·雨果
quoteCn: 笑声，是那道能融化人脸冰霜的暖阳。
quoteEn: Laughter is the sunshine that drives winter from the human face.

author: 托马斯·曼
quoteCn: 生命如白驹过隙，艺术却能永恒流传；机遇稍纵即逝，每一次尝试都暗藏风险；而做出判断，更是难上加难。
quoteEn: Life is short, art is long, opportunity fleeting, experiment dangerous, judgment difficult.

author: 维克多·雨果
quoteCn: 生命如一场幻梦，而爱，是那梦境中唯一真实的苏醒。
quoteEn: Life is a dream, love is its awakening.

author: 文森特·范·戈 Gogh
quoteCn: 艺术，是为那些被生活磨损得支离破碎的灵魂，献上温柔的慰藉。
quoteEn: Art is to console those who are broken by life.

author: 维克多·雨果
quoteCn: 爱吧，去爱吧，除此之外，万物皆虚无。
quoteEn: Love, love, everything else is nothing.

author: 文森特·范·戈 Gogh
quoteCn: 我以梦为画，以画为梦。在色彩与笔触间，灵魂得以自由呼吸。
quoteEn: I dream my painting and I paint my dream.

author: 弗吉尼亚·伍尔夫
quoteCn: 我所追逐的并非金钱，而是那份无拘无束的自由。
quoteEn: I am not interested in money. I am interested in freedom.

author: 维吉尔
quoteCn: 若命运不允，我便逆转乾坤，搅动深渊。
quoteEn: If I cannot bend the higher powers, I will move Acheron.

author: 伏尔泰
quoteCn: 怀疑，是灵魂深处隐隐的不安，但那份自以为是的笃定，却常常是人间最荒谬的执念。
quoteEn: Doubt is an unpleasant state, but certainty is ridiculous.

author: 威廉·巴特勒·叶芝
quoteCn: 此地无陌生人，只有你尚未相逢的灵魂伴侣。
quoteEn: There are no strangers here; Only friends you haven't yet met.

author: 托马斯·沃尔夫
quoteCn: 我相信我们在这片土地上迷失了，但我更相信，我们终将被寻回。
quoteEn: I believe that we are lost here in America, but I believe we shall be found.

author: W.H. 奥登
quoteCn: 让所有时钟停摆吧，掐断电话线。
quoteEn: Stop all the clocks, cut off the telephone

author: 维尔纳·海森堡
quoteCn: 决定我们心境的，从来不是事情本身，而是我们选择如何去看待它。
quoteEn: Not the facts themselves are decisive, but the way we see them.

author: 维尔纳·海森堡
quoteCn: 我们所见的，并非世界本来的样子，而是我们带着疑问、带着心境去触碰它时，它所呈现的倒影。
quoteEn: What we observe is not nature itself, but nature exposed to our questioning.

author: 维吉尔
quoteCn: 那些因害怕无法成功而止步不前的人，早已在原地坐下，放弃了前行的可能。
quoteEn: Sedit qui timuit ne non succederet.

author: 威廉·巴特勒·叶芝
quoteCn: 我将起身，即刻启程，去往茵尼斯弗利。在那里，我要亲手筑起一座小木屋，用泥土和柳枝，编织我的归宿。
quoteEn: I will arise and go now, and go to Innisfree, And a small cabin build there, of clay and wattles made.

author: 威廉·福克纳
quoteCn: 那些你明知不可得，却依然为之倾尽所有的，才是生命中最值得搏击的。它不是结果，而是你灵魂深处那份不屈的火焰。
quoteEn: The only thing worth fighting for is what you can't win.

author: 弗拉基米尔·纳博科夫
quoteCn: 我们是那群，在现实的粪堆上，依然翩跹起舞的蝴蝶。
quoteEn: We are the butterflies fluttering around the dung-heap of reality.

author: 弗拉基米尔·纳博科夫
quoteCn: 洛丽塔，我生命中那道光，我欲念中燃起的火。我的罪孽，我的灵魂。
quoteEn: Lolita, light of my life, fire of my loins. My sin, my soul.

author: 维.S. 奈保尔
quoteCn: 我们每个人的命运都与他人紧密相连，无论我们是否愿意承认，或是否选择参与其中。
quoteEn: We are all involved in each other's fate, whether we choose to be or not.

author: 沃尔特·迪士尼
quoteCn: 我拍电影，不只为孩子。我拍，是为了我们每个人心中那个永不老去的孩童，无论你六岁，还是六十。
quoteEn: I don't make films primarily for children. I make them for the child in all of us, whether we be six or sixty.

author: 弗拉基米尔·纳博科夫
quoteCn: 摇篮在深渊之上轻轻摇晃，而我们那所谓的“常识”却低语着：此生不过是两片永恒黑夜间，一道转瞬即逝的光隙。
quoteEn: The cradle rocks above an abyss, and common sense tells us that our existence is but a brief crack of light between two eternities of darkness.

author: 威廉·布莱克
quoteCn: 猛虎，猛虎，夜色森林中燃灼的辉煌；是何等不朽之手，何等不朽之眼，竟敢雕琢你这令人敬畏的对称？
quoteEn: Tyger Tyger, burning bright, In the forests of the night; What immortal hand or eye, Could frame thy fearful symmetry?

author: 威廉·布莱克
quoteCn: 真正的炼金术士，并非点石成金，而是将这浩瀚世界，凝练成字句，让无形化为有声，让瞬间化为永恒。
quoteEn: The true alchymist does not change lead into gold; he changes the world into words.

author: 威廉·莎士比亚
quoteCn: 爱，非眼之所见，乃心之所悟。
quoteEn: Love looks not with the eyes, but with the mind.

author: 威廉·布莱克
quoteCn: 紧握欢愉，便扼杀了它飞翔的生命；唯有轻吻那掠过的喜悦，方能永浴于永恒的晨曦。
quoteEn: He who binds to himself a joy, Does the winged life destroy; But he who kisses the joy as it flies, Lives in eternity's sunrise.

author: 弗吉尼亚·伍尔夫
quoteCn: 身为女子，我无国界。身为女子，我亦不求国界。身为女子，我的国度，是整个世界。
quoteEn: As a woman, I have no country. As a woman I want no country. As a woman, my country is the whole world.

author: 埃米尔·左拉
quoteCn: 人生若无幻梦一场，何以堪此清醒的荒凉。
quoteEn: Life is bearable only if one is drunk on an illusion.

author: 弗吉尼亚·伍尔夫
quoteCn: 好奇的灵魂，没有枷锁能将其禁锢。
quoteEn: No lock can hold back the curious.

author: 沃尔特·惠特曼
quoteCn: 那些最激昂、最温柔的歌谣，仍在等待被你我唱响。
quoteEn: The strongest and sweetest songs yet remain to be sung.

author: 埃米尔·左拉
quoteCn: 艺术，不过是自然的一隅，被某颗独特的心灵温柔或炽热地凝视。
quoteEn: Art is a corner of nature seen through a temperament.

author: 威廉·佩利
quoteCn: 这世界，终究是美好的。空气、大地、水流，无不充盈着喜悦的生机。无论是春日正午，还是夏夜黄昏，我目光所及之处，皆是万物欢欣的景象。
quoteEn: It is a happy world after all. The air, the earth, the water teem with delighted existence. In a spring noon, or a summer evening, on whichever side I turn my eyes, myriads of happy beings crowd upon my view.

author: 威廉·巴特勒·叶芝
quoteCn: 思量啊，人的荣光究竟从何处启程，又将归于何处寂灭。
quoteEn: Think where man's glory most begins and ends

author: 维克多·弗兰克尔
quoteCn: 只要心中有那份非活不可的理由，再艰难的'如何'，都能被我们温柔地承载。
quoteEn: He who has a why to live for can bear almost any how.

author: 沃尔夫冈·阿马德乌斯·莫扎特
quoteCn: 音乐，是灵魂深处无声的低语。
quoteEn: Music is the language of the soul.

author: 沃尔特·惠特曼
quoteCn: 啊，船长！我的船长！我们那令人心悸的旅程，终于画上了句点。
quoteEn: O Captain! My Captain! our fearful trip is done.

author: W.H. 奥登
quoteCn: 地球围绕太阳公转，而太阳，则围绕着爱，无休止地运转。
quoteEn: The Earth revolves around the Sun, and the Sun revolves around Love.

author: 维尔纳·海森堡
quoteCn: 现代物理学轻声细语，世界并非你我眼中所见，它远比想象中更深邃，更充满未知。
quoteEn: The modern physics has taught us that the world is not as it appears to us.

author: 沃尔夫冈·阿马德乌斯·莫扎特
quoteCn: 仅仅弹对音符，那只是手指的机械运动。真正动人的，是触及音乐深处那份无形而又鲜活的灵魂。
quoteEn: It is not enough to play the notes correctly. One must understand the soul of the music.

author: 维克多·弗兰克尔
quoteCn: 生命并非弗洛伊德所说的，只为寻欢作乐；也不是阿德勒所教的，只为追逐权力。生命，是一场对意义的永恒叩问。
quoteEn: Life is not primarily a quest for pleasure, as Freud believed, or a quest for power, as Adler taught, but a quest for meaning.

author: 威廉·巴特勒·叶芝
quoteCn: 我将起身，即刻动身，去往那伊尼斯弗里。
quoteEn: I will arise and go now, and go to Innisfree

author: 威廉·布莱克
